create trigger POSDEL_BUS
on R5BUDGETSTRUCTURE
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(17)        
	declare @sDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sParent     	nvarchar(17)        
	declare @sCal        	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @nPeri       	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nLoc        	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nMrc        	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nObj        	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nJbtp       	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nCstp       	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nLevel      	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @sOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	BUS_CODE,	BUS_DESC,	BUS_PARENT,	BUS_CAL,	BUS_PERI,
													  	BUS_LOC,	BUS_MRC,	BUS_OBJ,	BUS_JBTP,	BUS_CSTP,
													  	BUS_LEVEL,	BUS_ORG,	BUS_UPDATECOUNT,	BUS_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sParent,	@sCal,	@nPeri,
												   	@nLoc,	@nMrc,	@nObj,	@nJbtp,	@nCstp,
												   	@nLevel,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX           = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'BSTR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
  
							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sParent,	@sCal,	@nPeri,
														   	@nLoc,	@nMrc,	@nObj,	@nJbtp,	@nCstp,
														   	@nLevel,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger POSDEL_CAU
on R5CAUSES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select CAU_CODE from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
						     /* W01350 - Delete associated data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CAUS', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_CCP
  ON r5assetclassdefcapacities
  FOR DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sOcdpk             nvarchar(30)
  DECLARE @sCapacitycode      nvarchar(8)
  DECLARE @dEffectivedate     datetime
  DECLARE @dExpiredate        datetime
  DECLARE @sUser              nvarchar(38)
  DECLARE @dMineffectivedate  datetime
  DECLARE @dMaxeffectivedate  datetime

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT ccp_ocdpk, ccp_capacitycode, 
              ccp_effective, ccp_expired
      FROM   DELETED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sOcdpk, @sCapacitycode, @dEffectivedate, @dExpiredate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SELECT @dMaxeffectivedate = MAX( ccp_effective ) 
              FROM   r5assetclassdefcapacities
              WHERE  ccp_ocdpk         = @sOcdpk
              AND    ccp_capacitycode  = @sCapacitycode
              AND    ccp_effective     < @dEffectivedate

              IF @dMaxeffectivedate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @dMineffectivedate = MIN( ccp_effective ) - 1
                  FROM   r5assetclassdefcapacities
                  WHERE  ccp_ocdpk         = @sOcdpk
                  AND    ccp_capacitycode  = @sCapacitycode
                  AND    ccp_effective     > @dEffectivedate
                  
                  SET @dMineffectivedate = ISNULL( @dMineffectivedate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

                  UPDATE r5assetclassdefcapacities
                  SET    ccp_expired        = @dMineffectivedate
                  WHERE  ccp_ocdpk          = @sOcdpk
                  AND    ccp_capacitycode   = @sCapacitycode
                  AND    ccp_effective      = @dMaxeffectivedate
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sOcdpk, @sCapacitycode, @dEffectivedate, @dExpiredate
            END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_CFM
  ON r5compfuelmix
  FOR DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sSupplier    NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sSuporg      NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sCommodity   NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sType        NVARCHAR(8)
  DECLARE @nCapacity    NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @dFromdate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @dTodate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @sUser        NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @dMinfromdate DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxfromdate DATETIME

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT cfm_supplier, cfm_supplier_org, cfm_commodity, cfm_type,
             cfm_capacity, cfm_fromdate, cfm_todate
      FROM   DELETED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sSupplier, @sSuporg, @sCommodity, 
                @sType, @nCapacity, @dFromdate, @dTodate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SELECT @dMaxfromdate = MAX( cfm_fromdate ) 
              FROM   r5compfuelmix
              WHERE  cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
              AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSuporg
              AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
              AND    cfm_type         = @sType
              AND    cfm_fromdate     < @dFromdate;

              IF @dMaxfromdate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @dMinfromdate = MIN( cfm_fromdate ) - 1
                  FROM   r5compfuelmix
                  WHERE  cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
                  AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSuporg
                  AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
                  AND    cfm_type         = @sType
                  AND    cfm_fromdate     > @dFromdate
                  SET @dMinfromdate = ISNULL( @dMinfromdate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

                  UPDATE r5compfuelmix
                  SET    cfm_todate       = @dMinfromdate
                  WHERE  cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
                  AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSuporg
                  AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
                  AND    cfm_type         = @sType
                  AND    cfm_fromdate     = @dMaxfromdate
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sSupplier, @sSuporg, @sCommodity, 
                    @sType, @nCapacity, @dFromdate, @dTodate
            END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

as

	declare @dExpiredate  	datetime            
	declare @sClass       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sMfgmatchflag	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOrg         	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dClosedate   	datetime            
	declare @sClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer   
	declare @dLastsav	datetime
	
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChk1			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nErecord		int
	declare @sGetUser		nvarchar(255)
	declare @dGtTime		datetime
	declare @sGetStype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sSeqno			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sCertnum			nvarchar(20)	--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certification%TYPE
	declare @sCerttype			nvarchar(8)		--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certificationtype%TYPE
	          

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	CNH_CODE,	CNH_MANUFACT,	CNH_STATUS,	CNH_RSTATUS,		CNH_STARTDATE,
									CNH_EXPIREDATE,	CNH_CLASS,	CNH_DESC,	CNH_MFGMATCHFLAG,	CNH_ORG,
									CNH_CLOSEDATE,	CNH_CLASS_ORG,	CNH_UPDATECOUNT,CNH_SQLIDENTITY,	CNH_LASTSAVED
							from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sManufact,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@dStartdate,
									@dExpiredate,	@sClass,	@sDesc,	@sMfgmatchflag,	@sOrg,
									@dClosedate,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity, @dLastsav
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--POSDEL 
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CHNO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							delete from r5changenoticelines where cnl_cn = @sCode
							
							execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'DEL', N'CHNO', @sStatus, N'-'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return

							if @nErecord > 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

create trigger POSDEL_CSM
on r5casemanagement
instead of delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser            nvarchar(38)
  declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4)
  declare @sCode            nvarchar(30)
  declare @sOrg            nvarchar(15)
  declare @nReturn          int	
  declare @nErecord         int
  declare @sStatus          nvarchar(4)
  declare @nWOReturn		int
  declare @sWOCheckresult 	nvarchar(4)
  declare @sKeyCode			nvarchar(50)
  

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare c_deleted cursor local for select csm_code, csm_org, csm_status from deleted
      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
            begin
              deallocate c_deleted
              rollback transaction
              RETURN
            end
          open c_deleted 
          fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sStatus
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              set @sCheckresult = N'0'
              set @sWOCheckresult = N'0'
              set @sKeyCode = @sCode
              execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', NULL, N'CASE', NULL, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, NULL, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
              execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', NULL, N'CASW', NULL, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, NULL, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
              
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_deleted
                  deallocate c_deleted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

                if @sCheckresult <> N'0' or @sWOCheckresult <> N'0'
                  begin
                    close c_deleted
                    deallocate c_deleted
                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sWOCheckresult, @@ERROR
                    rollback transaction
                    return
                  end
                execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'DEL', N'CASE', @sStatus, N'-'
                
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
                begin
                  close c_deleted
                  deallocate c_deleted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              if @nErecord > 0 
                begin
                  /* Elec archive. */
                  execute @nReturn = o7csmelecarchive N'DELETE', @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                  begin
                    close c_deleted
                    deallocate c_deleted
                    rollback transaction
                    return
                  end
                end

              /* Delete actual CSM record. */
              delete from r5casemanagement where csm_code = @sCode
              
              fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sStatus
            end
          close c_deleted
        end
      deallocate c_deleted
    end

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_CSP
  ON r5contractsalesprice
  FOR DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sCspContract	     	NVARCHAR(50)  
  DECLARE @sCspContractRevision  		NUMERIC(8, 0)
  DECLARE @sCspContractOrg     	NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sCspPk     		NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sCspRentity        	NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @sCspStore        	NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sCspOrg     		NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @dCspStartDate   DATETIME
  DECLARE @sUser          	NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @dMinfromdate   	DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxfromdate   	DATETIME

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT csp_pk, csp_contract, csp_contractrevision, csp_contract_org, csp_rentity, csp_org, 
             csp_startdate, csp_store
      FROM   DELETED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sCspPk, @sCspContract, @sCspContractRevision, @sCspContractOrg, @sCspRentity, @sCspOrg,  
                 @dCspStartDate, @sCspStore
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SELECT @dMaxfromdate = MAX(csp_startdate) 
              FROM   r5contractsalesprice
              WHERE  csp_contract	=	@sCspContract
              AND	 csp_contractrevision	=	@sCspContractRevision
              AND	 csp_contract_org	=	@sCspContractOrg
              AND	 csp_rentity    =	@sCspRentity
              AND    csp_org 		= 	@sCspOrg
              AND    ISNULL(csp_store,'')  	=	ISNULL(@sCspStore,'')
              AND    csp_startdate   < @dCspStartDate;
              IF @dMaxfromdate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @dMinfromdate = MIN(csp_startdate) - 1
                  FROM   r5contractsalesprice
                  WHERE  csp_rentity    = @sCspRentity
                  AND    csp_org 	= @sCspOrg
                  AND    ISNULL(csp_store,'')  = ISNULL(@sCspStore,'')
                  AND    csp_startdate   > @dCspStartDate
                  SET @dMinfromdate = ISNULL( @dMinfromdate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

                  UPDATE r5contractsalesprice
                  SET    csp_enddate     = @dMinfromdate
                  WHERE  csp_contract	=	@sCspContract
				  AND	 csp_contractrevision	=	@sCspContractRevision
				  AND	 csp_contract_org	=	@sCspContractOrg
                  AND    csp_rentity     = @sCspRentity
                  AND    csp_org 	= @sCspOrg
                  AND    ISNULL(csp_store,'')  = ISNULL(@sCspStore,'')
                  AND    csp_startdate   = @dMaxfromdate
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sCspPk, @sCspContract, @sCspContractRevision, @sCspContractOrg, @sCspRentity, @sCspOrg,  
                 	@dCspStartDate, @sCspStore
            END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

on R5DOCENTITIES
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as

	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sREntity     	nvarchar(30)

		begin

							end

						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger POSDEL_DBE
on R5DATABRIDGEERRORS
for delete
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     	integer       
	declare @nXtsseqnum   	integer             
	declare @nParentseqnum	integer             
	declare @dCreate      	datetime            
	declare @sErrormessage	varchar(4000)       
	declare @nGltransid   	integer             
	declare @nRunid       	integer             
	declare @sGltable     	nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sGlprocess   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sTblrowid    	nvarchar(250)       
	declare @nGlentryid   	integer             
	declare @sUpdatecount 	nvarchar(38)        
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer
	declare @nReturn		integer             

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	DBE_TRANSID,	DBE_XTSSEQNUM,	DBE_PARENTSEQNUM,	DBE_CREATE,	DBE_ERRORMESSAGE,
													  	DBE_GLTRANSID,	DBE_RUNID,	DBE_GLTABLE,	DBE_GLPROCESS,	DBE_TBLROWID,
													  	DBE_GLENTRYID,	DBE_UPDATECOUNT,	DBE_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@nTransid,	@nXtsseqnum,	@nParentseqnum,	@dCreate,	@sErrormessage,
												   	@nGltransid,	@nRunid,	@sGltable,	@sGlprocess,	@sTblrowid,
												   	@nGlentryid,	@sUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							INSERT INTO r5databridgeerrorshist
									(dbh_transid,
									dbh_xtsseqnum,
									dbh_parentseqnum,
									dbh_create,
									dbh_errormessage,
									dbh_gltransid,
									dbh_runid,
									dbh_gltable,
									dbh_glprocess,
									dbh_tblrowid,
									dbh_glentryid,
									dbh_archive)
							VALUES
									(@nTransid,
									@nXtsseqnum,
									@nParentseqnum,
									@dCreate,
									@sErrormessage,
									@nGltransid,
									@nRunid,
									@sGltable,
									@sGlprocess,
									@sTblrowid,
									@nGlentryid,
									GetDate())
							
							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@nTransid,	@nXtsseqnum,	@nParentseqnum,	@dCreate,	@sErrormessage,
														   	@nGltransid,	@nRunid,	@sGltable,	@sGlprocess,	@sTblrowid,
														   	@nGlentryid,	@sUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted

			--This code is outside of the if user <> sys check in Oracle 
			-- and really only needs to be run once for the whole delete anyway.
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_totentries', '0'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					rollback transaction
					return
				end
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_ESP
  ON r5entitysalesprices
  FOR DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sEsppk     		NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sRentity        	NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @sEspcode	     	NVARCHAR(50)
  DECLARE @nSalesprice 		NUMERIC(24,6)  
  DECLARE @sStore        	NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sEsporg     		NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @dDateeffective   DATETIME
  DECLARE @dDateexpired     DATETIME
  DECLARE @sUser          	NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @dMinfromdate   	DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxfromdate   	DATETIME

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT esp_pk, esp_rentity, esp_code, esp_org, 
             esp_salesprice, esp_dateeffective, esp_dateexpired, esp_store
      FROM   DELETED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sEsppk, @sRentity, @sEspcode, @sEsporg,  
                 @nSalesprice,   @dDateeffective, @dDateexpired, @sStore
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SELECT @dMaxfromdate = MAX(esp_dateeffective) 
              FROM   r5entitysalesprices
              WHERE  esp_rentity    =	@sRentity
              AND    esp_org 		= 	@sEsporg
              AND    ISNULL(esp_store,'')  	=	ISNULL(@sStore,'')
              AND    esp_dateeffective   < @dDateeffective;
              IF @dMaxfromdate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @dMinfromdate = MIN(esp_dateeffective) - 1
                  FROM   r5entitysalesprices
                  WHERE  esp_rentity    = @sRentity
                  AND    esp_org 	= @sEsporg
                  AND    ISNULL(esp_store,'')  = ISNULL(@sStore,'')
                  AND    esp_dateeffective   > @dDateeffective
                  SET @dMinfromdate = ISNULL( @dMinfromdate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

                  UPDATE r5entitysalesprices
                  SET    esp_dateexpired     = @dMinfromdate
                  WHERE  esp_rentity     = @sRentity
                  AND    esp_org 	= @sEsporg
                  AND    ISNULL(esp_store,'')  = ISNULL(@sStore,'')
                  AND    esp_dateeffective   = @dMaxfromdate
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sEsppk, @sRentity, @sEspcode, @sEsporg,  
                 	@nSalesprice,   @dDateeffective, @dDateexpired, @sStore
            END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

create trigger POSDEL_FAC
on R5FACILITIES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select FAC_CODE, FAC_ORG from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							/* M0935 - Deleting dependant data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'FAC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_FUB
ON r5functionusertabs
FOR DELETE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sUser        nvarchar(38)
  DECLARE @sFunction    nvarchar(6)
  DECLARE @sTab         nvarchar(6)
  DECLARE @sSysFunction nvarchar(6)
  DECLARE @sUrl         nvarchar(2000)
  DECLARE @sType        nvarchar(1)

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT fub_function, fub_tab, fub_type, fub_url FROM deleted
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN c_deleted
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sFunction, @sTab, @sType, @sUrl
            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
              BEGIN
                IF @sFunction LIKE '%/eamdwg/%' AND @sType = 'H'
                  BEGIN
                  SELECT @sSysFunction = COALESCE(fun_application,fun_code) FROM r5functions WHERE fun_code = @sFunction
                  IF @sSysFunction IN ('BSDOCU','BSQUER','OSOBJA','OSOBJL','OSOBJP','OSOBJS','SSPART','WSJOBS','OSWKSP')
                    BEGIN
                      --update boiler text entry to OCA
                      UPDATE r5boilertexts SET bot_fld1='OCA'
                      WHERE  bot_number = (CASE WHEN @sSysFunction = 'BSDOCU' THEN 49
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'BSQUER' THEN 40
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'OSOBJA' THEN 2246
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'OSOBJL' THEN 949
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'OSOBJP' THEN 2097
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'OSOBJS' THEN 1977
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'SSPART' THEN 1057
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'WSJOBS' THEN 2476
                                                WHEN @sSysFunction = 'OSWKSP' THEN 97
                                          END)
                     AND bot_function = @sFunction
                     AND bot_fld1 = @sTab
                  END
                END
                -- Delete associated r5urlparameters data
                DELETE FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab;
                DELETE FROM r5reporttabparammap WHERE rpm_function = @sFunction AND rpm_tab = @sTab;
                FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sFunction, @sTab, @sType, @sUrl
              END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

create trigger POSDEL_ISP
on R5ISOLATIONPOINTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser            nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX               nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sKeyCode         nvarchar(40)
    declare @nRevision        int
    declare @sOrg             nvarchar(15)
    declare @nReturn          int

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_deleted cursor local for select ISP_CODE, ISP_ORG,ISP_REVISION from deleted
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_deleted 
                    fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg,@nRevision
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sKeyCode = @sCode + '#' + @sOrg + '#' + CAST(@nRevision AS nvarchar(4))
                            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'ILPO', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_deleted
                                    deallocate c_deleted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                                begin
                                    close c_deleted
                                    deallocate c_deleted
                                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg,@nRevision
                        end
                    close c_deleted
                end
            deallocate c_deleted
        end

													  	KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM,	KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG,	KBA_MRC,	KBA_PROVIDER,	KBA_PROVIDER_ORG,
													  	KBA_SERVICECATEGORY,	KBA_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG,	KBA_DOCUMENT,	KBA_CREATED,	KBA_UPDATED,
													  	KBA_UPDATEDBY,	KBA_CREATEDBY,	KBA_UPDATECOUNT,	KBA_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
												   	@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@sMrc,	@sProvider,	@sProvider_org,
												   	@sServicecategory,	@sServicecategory_org,	@sDocument,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
												   	@sUpdatedby,	@sCreatedby,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							DELETE FROM r5kbarticledetails where kbd_kbarticle = @sCode AND kbd_kbarticle_org= @sOrg

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							/* Delete dependant data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'KWBS',N'*', N'*',  @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							DELETE FROM R5KBARTICLES where KBA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity
							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
														   	@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@sMrc,	@sProvider,	@sProvider_org,
														   	@sServicecategory,	@sServicecategory_org,	@sDocument,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
														   	@sUpdatedby,	@sCreatedby,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end

				end

		end

  declare @sPtw             nvarchar(50)
  declare @sREntity         nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX               nvarchar(1)
  declare @sChk             nvarchar(4)
  declare @nReturn          int    

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      SET @sX = NULL
      declare c_deleted cursor local for select ksf_pk, ksf_code, ksf_rentity from deleted
      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          open c_deleted 
          fetch next from c_deleted into @sPk, @sPtw, @sREntity
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'SFWO', @sX, N'*', @sPk, @sX, @sX, @sChk OUTPUT
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_deleted
                  deallocate c_deleted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end
			  if @sREntity = N'PTW'
			    begin
				  /* Reset Permit To Work esignature information. */
				  UPDATE r5permittowork SET ptw_reviewed = null, ptw_reviewedby = null, ptw_reviewedtype = null WHERE ptw_code = @sPtw;
				end
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_deleted
                  deallocate c_deleted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              fetch next from c_deleted into @sPk, @sPtw, @sREntity
            end
          close c_deleted
        end

    end

on R5MATLPARTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION

	declare @nMatlrev	numeric(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin

				end

		end

   declare @sX            nvarchar(1)
   declare @sCode         nvarchar(24)
   declare @sOrg          nvarchar(15)
   declare @nReturn       int

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_deleted cursor local for select MRC_CODE, MRC_ORG from deleted
         set @sX = NULL
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_deleted 
               fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                     execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'MRC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     /* Delete from the budget items table. */
                     DELETE FROM r5budgetitems
                     WHERE  bit_code = @sCode
                     AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                             FROM   r5budgetgroups
                             WHERE  bgr_code = bit_group
                             AND    bgr_rentity = N'MRC' )

                     fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
                  end
               close c_deleted
            end

on r5objectsurvey
for delete
as
   declare @sUser       nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @sObject     nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @sObjectOrg  nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sType       nvarchar(1)
   DECLARE @sLevelpk    nvarchar(30)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT obs_object, obs_object_org, obs_type, obs_levelpk FROM deleted
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_deleted
               fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sType, @sLevelpk
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     IF @sType = 'O'
                        -- Update column obj_rrsurveylastupdated
                        UPDATE r5objects
                        SET    obj_rrsurveylastupdated = dbo.o7gttime2( @sObjectOrg )

                                       AND    rrl_org                = obj_reliabilityranking_org

                     ELSE
                        -- Update column rrv_surveylastupdated
                        UPDATE r5reliabilityrankingvalues
                        SET    rrv_surveylastupdated = dbo.o7gttime2( rrv_org ),
                               rrv_reliabilityrankingscore = NULL,
                               rrv_reliabilityrankingindex = NULL,
                               rrv_valueslastcalculated = NULL
                        WHERE  rrv_pk = @sObject

                     fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sType, @sLevelpk
                  end
               close c_deleted
            end

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_OCP
  ON r5objectcapacities
  FOR DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sObject          nvarchar(30)
  DECLARE @sObjectorg       nvarchar(15)
  DECLARE @sCapacitycode    nvarchar(8)
  DECLARE @dEffectivedate   datetime
  DECLARE @dExpiredate      datetime
  DECLARE @sUser            nvarchar(38)
  DECLARE @dMineffectivedate datetime
  DECLARE @dMaxeffectivedate datetime

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT ocp_object, ocp_object_org, ocp_capacitycode, ocp_effective, ocp_expired
      FROM   DELETED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sCapacitycode, @dEffectivedate, @dExpiredate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SELECT @dMaxeffectivedate = MAX( ocp_effective ) 
              FROM   r5objectcapacities
              WHERE  ocp_object       = @sObject
              AND    ocp_object_org   = @sObjectorg
              AND    ocp_capacitycode = @sCapacitycode
              AND    ocp_effective    < @dEffectivedate

              IF @dMaxeffectivedate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @dMineffectivedate = MIN( ocp_effective ) - 1
                  FROM   r5objectcapacities
                  WHERE  ocp_object        = @sObject
                  AND    ocp_object_org    = @sObjectorg
                  AND    ocp_capacitycode  = @sCapacitycode
                  AND    ocp_effective     > @dEffectivedate
                  
                  SET @dMineffectivedate = ISNULL( @dMineffectivedate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

                  UPDATE r5objectcapacities
                  SET    ocp_expired       = @dMineffectivedate
                  WHERE  ocp_object        = @sObject
                  AND    ocp_object_org    = @sObjectorg
                  AND    ocp_capacitycode  = @sCapacitycode
                  AND    ocp_effective     = @dMaxeffectivedate
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sCapacitycode, @dEffectivedate, @dExpiredate
            END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_ODC
  ON r5objdesignconsumption
  FOR DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sObject        NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObjorg        NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sCommodity     NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @nDesignconrate NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sDesignuom     NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sParent        NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sParentorg     NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @dFromdate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @dTodate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @sUser          NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @dMinfromdate   DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxfromdate   DATETIME

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT odc_object, odc_object_org, odc_commodity, odc_designusageuom, 
             odc_designconsumptionrate, odc_parentutlbillobject, odc_parentutlbillobject_org, 
             odc_fromdate, odc_todate
      FROM   DELETED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sObject, @sObjorg, @sCommodity, 
                @sDesignuom, @nDesignconrate, @sParent, @sParentorg, @dFromdate, @dTodate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SELECT @dMaxfromdate = MAX( odc_fromdate ) 
              FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
              WHERE  odc_object     = @sObject
              AND    odc_object_org = @sObjorg
              AND    odc_commodity  = @sCommodity
              AND    odc_fromdate   < @dFromdate;

              IF @dMaxfromdate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @dMinfromdate = MIN( odc_fromdate ) - 1
                  FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
                  WHERE  odc_object     = @sObject
                  AND    odc_object_org = @sObjorg
                  AND    odc_commodity  = @sCommodity
                  AND    odc_fromdate   > @dFromdate
                  SET @dMinfromdate = ISNULL( @dMinfromdate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

                  UPDATE r5objdesignconsumption

create trigger POSDEL_ORS
on R5OBJRESOURCES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
        declare @sUser          nvarchar(38)
        declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
        declare @sObject        nvarchar(30)
        declare @sObjectOrg     nvarchar(15)
        declare @sResource      nvarchar(80)
        declare @sActive        nvarchar(1)
        declare @nCoolDownTime  numeric(7,2)
        declare @nWarmupTime    numeric(7,2)
        declare @nUpdateCount   int
        declare @sEAMUser       nvarchar(255)    
        declare @dDate          datetime
        declare @nCount         int
        declare @nReturn        int

        if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                begin
                        /* get eam user */
                        execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sEAMUser OUTPUT
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                           return
                
                        set @sEAMUser = coalesce(@sEAMUser, N'*')
                        
                        /* get system date */
                        execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, null
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                          return                
                          
                        SET NOCOUNT ON
                        declare c_deleted cursor local for select ORS_OBJECT, ORS_OBJECT_ORG, ORS_RESOURCE,ORS_COOLDOWNTIME, ORS_WARMUPTIME,ORS_ACTIVE,ORS_UPDATECOUNT from deleted
                        set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
                        if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                                begin
                                        open c_deleted 
                                        fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource,@nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime,@sActive, @nUpdateCount
                                        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                                                begin
                                                        set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                                                        
                                                        select @nCount =count(*)
                                                        from r5objresources
                                                        where  ors_object = @sObject and ors_object_org = @sObjectOrg 
                                                        
                                                        
                                                        if @nCount =0
                                                           begin
                                                              /*  update r5objects table  to set resource present flag */
                                                                update r5objects set obj_resourcepresent = '-' 
                                                                where obj_code = @sObject
                                                                and obj_org = @sObjectOrg 
                                                                and coalesce (obj_resourcepresent, '-') = '+'                                                              
                                                           end

                                                        /* Create audit records */
                                                        INSERT INTO r5objresourcesaudit(
                                                            era_object,
                                                            era_object_org,
                                                            era_resource,
                                                            era_cooldowntime,
                                                            era_warmuptime,
                                                            era_active,
                                                            era_action,
                                                            era_modifiedby,
                                                            era_datemodified)
                                                        VALUES (
                                                            @sObject,
                                                            @sObjectOrg,
                                                            @sResource,
                                                            @nCoolDownTime,
                                                            @nWarmupTime,
                                                            @sActive,
                                                            N'DEL',
                                                            @sEAMUser,
                                                            @dDate )   

                                                        fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource,@nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime,@sActive, @nUpdateCount
                                                end
                                        close c_deleted
                                end
                        deallocate c_deleted
                end

create trigger POSDEL_PAR
on R5PARTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(2)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sNitmout		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)	


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select par_code, par_org, par_class from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							/* S3838 - Delete dependant data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'PART', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCITM'
							if @nCount > 0 
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCITM'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'

							if @sFlag = N'Y' or @sFlag = N'T'  --yaon #12306
							begin
								select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@NITMOUT'
								if @nCount > 0 
									select @sNitmout = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@NITMOUT'
								else
									set @sNitmout = N'N'
																								
								if @sNitmout=N'Y' or @sClass is null or @sClass <> N'N'
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_deleted
												deallocate c_deleted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

								 		INSERT INTO r5xmltranstatus (	xts_trantype, xts_table, xts_keyfld1, xts_keyfld2, xts_keyfld3, XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,XTS_ORG)
										VALUES (	N'SYNCITEM', N'R5PARTS', @sCode, @sOrg, N'D', @sTempMsgid, @sOrg)
									end
							end
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass

						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

on r5precautions
for delete

    declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX               nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sKeyCode         nvarchar(40)
    declare @nRevision        int
    declare @sOrg             nvarchar(15)
    declare @nReturn          int

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_deleted cursor local for select PCA_CODE, PCA_ORG,PCA_REVISION from deleted
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_deleted 
                    fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg,@nRevision
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sKeyCode = @sCode + '#' + @sOrg + '#' + CAST(@nRevision AS nvarchar(4))
                            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'PCTN', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_deleted
                                    deallocate c_deleted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                                begin
                                    close c_deleted
                                    deallocate c_deleted
                                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg,@nRevision

CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_PPO
ON R5PPMOBJECTS
FOR DELETE
AS
    declare @sSysUser            nvarchar(38)
    declare @sPpm                  nvarchar( 20 )
    declare @nRev                  numeric
    declare @nPpopk                integer
    declare @sPpoIssType        nvarchar(1)
    declare @sRstat                nvarchar(4)
    
    
    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_deleted cursor local for select ppo_ppm, ppo_revision,ppo_pk, ppo_isstype from deleted
            set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_deleted
                    fetch next from c_deleted into     @sPpm, @nRev, @nPpopk, @sPpoIssType
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sPpoIssType = N'D'
                            begin
                                SELECT @sRstat = ppm_revrstatus
                                FROM   r5ppms
                                WHERE  ppm_code = @sPpm
                                AND    ppm_revision = @nRev
                                if @sRstat = N'A' 
                                     /* Remove future duplicates. */
                                    DELETE FROM r5futureduplicates
                                    WHERE  fdp_ppopk = @nPpopk
                            end
                            fetch next from c_deleted into @sPpm, @nRev, @nPpopk, @sPpoIssType
                        end
                    close c_deleted
                end
            deallocate c_deleted
        end

create trigger POSDEL_PRQ
on R5PRODUCTIONREQUESTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser              nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX                 nvarchar(1)
    declare @nReturn            int
    declare @sCode              nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRevision          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOrg               nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc              nvarchar(80)
    declare @sClass             nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassOrg          nvarchar(15)
    declare @sWorkOrder         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sProdOrder         nvarchar(80)
    declare @dProdStart         datetime
    declare @dProdEnd           datetime
    declare @sAccEntity         nvarchar(22)
    declare @sStatus            nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRStatus           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEntLocation       nvarchar(80)
    declare @sProdPriority      nvarchar(256)
    declare @dProdReqStart      datetime
    declare @dProdReqEnd        datetime
    declare @dCreated           datetime
    declare @sCreatedby         nvarchar(255)
    declare @dLastStatusUpdate  datetime
    declare @nUpdatecount       numeric(38)
    declare @sSeqno             nvarchar(30)
    declare @sChk1              nvarchar(6)
    declare @sGetUser           nvarchar(255)
    declare @dGtTime            datetime
    declare @sGetStype          nvarchar(8)
    declare @sCertnum           nvarchar(20)
    declare @sCerttype          nvarchar(8)
    declare @nErecord           int
    declare @sCodeRevision		nvarchar(35)
    declare @sRevisionreason    nvarchar(2000)


    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_deleted cursor local for select prq_code, prq_revision, prq_org, prq_desc, prq_class, prq_class_org, prq_productionorder, prq_productionstart, prq_productionend, prq_accountingentity, prq_event, prq_status, prq_rstatus, prq_enterpriselocation, prq_priority, prq_prodrequeststart, prq_prodrequestend, prq_createdby, prq_created, prq_laststatusupdate, prq_updatecount, prq_revisionreason from deleted
            set @sX = NULL
            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_deleted 
                    fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sRevision, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass,@sClassOrg, @sProdOrder, @dProdStart, @dProdEnd, @sAccEntity, @sWorkOrder, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sEntLocation, @sProdPriority, @dProdReqStart, @dProdReqEnd, @sCreatedby, @dCreated, @dLastStatusUpdate, @nUpdatecount, @sRevisionreason
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                             set @sCodeRevision = @sCode + N'#' + @sRevision
                            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'PREQ', @sX, N'*', @sCodeRevision, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_deleted
                                    deallocate c_deleted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                                begin
                                    close c_deleted
                                    deallocate c_deleted
                                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

			execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'DEL', N'PREQ', @sStatus, N'-'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close c_deleted
					deallocate c_deleted
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			if @nErecord > 0 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_deleted
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end
									
					execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_deleted
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_deleted
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_deleted
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYNUM @sCertnum OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_deleted
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYTYPE @sCerttype OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_deleted
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					INSERT  INTO r5elecarchive (
					ELA_CODE,            ELA_USER,             ELA_DATE,            ELA_SIGNTYPE,
					ELA_CERTIFYNUM,      ELA_CERTIFYTYPE,      ELA_SCODE,           ELA_ENTITY,
					ELA_ENTCODE,         ELA_ENTORG,           ELA_STATUS,          ELA_PARENT,
					ELA_FLD1,            ELA_FLD2,             ELA_FLD3,            ELA_FLD4,
					ELA_FLD5,            ELA_FLD6,             ELA_FLD7,            ELA_FLD8,
					ELA_FLD9,            ELA_FLD10,            ELA_FLD11,           ELA_FLD12,
					ELA_FLD13,           ELA_FLD14,            ELA_FLD15,           ELA_FLD16,
					ELA_FLD17,           ELA_FLD18,            ELA_FLD19,           ELA_FLD20,
					ELA_FLD21,           ELA_FLD22 )
					VALUES( @sSeqno,@sGetUser,@dGtTime,@sGetStype,
					@sCertnum,@sCerttype,null,N'PREQ',@sCode,@sOrg,@sStatus,null,
					@sCode,@sRevision,@sDesc,@sOrg,@sClass,
					@sClassOrg,@sAccEntity,@sStatus,@sRStatus,@sWorkOrder, 
					dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dCreated, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),@sCreatedby,
					dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dProdStart, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
					dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dProdEnd, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
					dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dProdReqStart, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
					dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dProdReqEnd, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
					@sProdPriority,@sProdOrder,@sEntLocation,
					dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dLastStatusUpdate, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),
					@nUpdatecount, @sRevisionreason)
				end

                            fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sRevision, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass,@sClassOrg, @sProdOrder, @dProdStart, @dProdEnd, @sAccEntity, @sWorkOrder, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sEntLocation, @sProdPriority, @dProdReqStart, @dProdReqEnd, @sCreatedby, @dCreated, @dLastStatusUpdate, @nUpdatecount, @sRevisionreason
                        end
                    close c_deleted
                end
            deallocate c_deleted
        end

  ON r5patternsequences
  AFTER DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sUser       NVARCHAR(38)

  DECLARE @sMp         NVARCHAR(30) 
  DECLARE @sMporg      NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @nMpRev      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nMpSeq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sObj        NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObjorg     NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @dTarget     DATETIME
  DECLARE @nDuration   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nReturn     NUMERIC

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT evt_code, evt_mp, evt_mp_org, evt_mp_rev, evt_mp_seq, evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_target, evt_duration
      FROM   r5events, deleted
      WHERE  evt_mp      = psq_mp
      AND    evt_mp_org  = psq_mp_org
      AND    evt_mp_rev  = psq_revision
      AND    evt_rstatus = 'A'
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO 
                @sWo, @sMp, @sMporg, @nMpRev, @nMpseq, @sObj, @sObjorg, @dTarget, @nDuration
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              EXECUTE @nReturn = o7crfut2 @sWo, @sWo, @sMp, @sMporg, @nMprev, @nMpseq, 
                                          @sObj, @sObjorg, @dTarget, @nDuration
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO 
                    @sWo, @sMp, @sMporg, @nMpRev, @nMpseq, @sObj, @sObjorg, @dTarget, @nDuration
            END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

create trigger POSDEL_PTW
on r5permittowork
instead of delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser            nvarchar(38)
  declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4)
  declare @sCode            nvarchar(30)
  declare @nReturn          int	
  declare @nErecord         int
  declare @sStatus          nvarchar(4)

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare c_deleted cursor local for select PTW_CODE, PTW_STATUS from deleted
      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
            begin
              deallocate c_ins_del
              rollback transaction
              RETURN
            end
          open c_deleted 
          fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sStatus
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              set @sCheckresult = N'0'
              execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', NULL, N'PTW', NULL, N'*', @sCode, NULL, NULL, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_deleted
                  deallocate c_deleted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

                if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                  begin
                    close c_deleted
                    deallocate c_deleted
                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                    rollback transaction
                    return
                  end

              execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'DEL', N'PTW', @sStatus, N'-'
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
                begin
                  close c_deleted
                  deallocate c_deleted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              if @nErecord > 0 
                begin
                  /* Elec archive. */
                  execute @nReturn = o7ptwelecarchive N'DELETE', @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                  begin
                    close c_deleted
                    deallocate c_deleted
                    rollback transaction
                    return
                  end
                end

              /* Delete actual PTW record. */
              delete from r5permittowork where ptw_code = @sCode
              
              fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sStatus
            end
          close c_deleted
        end
      deallocate c_deleted
    end

on r5pumps
for delete
as
	declare @sUser          nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn        int
	declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDepot         nvarchar(64)
    declare @sTemp          nvarchar(128)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select pum_code, pum_depot_org, pum_depot from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDepot
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									rollback transaction

                  rollback transaction
                  return

            end
          close c_deleted
        end

create trigger POSDEL_QUT
on R5QUOTTASKS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sQuotation		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSeqno			nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCountit		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select QUT_QUOTATION, QUT_SEQNO from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @nCountit = 0

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sQuotation, @sSeqno
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTQ N'QUOT', N'*',  @sQuotation,  N'STAT', @sSeqno, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


								if @nCountit >= 0
									begin
										if @nCountit = 0 
											begin
												close c_deleted
												deallocate c_deleted
												execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_QUT', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										else
											set @sX = null
									end
								else
									begin
										if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
											begin
												close c_deleted
												deallocate c_deleted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXISTQ', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sQuotation, @sSeqno

							set @composite_code = @delrli_rfq + N'#' + @delrli_org + N'#' + cast(@delrli_rfqline as nvarchar)

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(25)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nRevision		numeric(4)
	declare @nError			int
	
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select ROU_CODE, ROU_REVISION, ROU_ORG from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @nRevision, @sOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCode = @sCode + N'#' + Cast(@nRevision as nvarchar(4))

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'ROUT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--9737: Schema Change
							DELETE FROM R5OBJMAP
							WHERE OMP_CODE = @sCode
								AND OMP_CODE_ORG = @sOrg
								AND OMP_TYPE = 1
							set @nError = @@ERROR
							if @nError <> 0 
							begin
								close c_deleted
								deallocate c_deleted
								execute O7RAE N'POSDEL_ROU2', N'TRIG', N'7', @nError
								rollback transaction
								return
							end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @nRevision, @sOrg
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

	END -- end of user-check if    
	deallocate deleted_row
END -- end of the main if

create trigger POSDEL_SDM
on R5OBJECTSDM
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sObject	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn	int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for
				select SDM_OBJECT, SDM_OBJECT_ORG
				from deleted

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = dbo.O7DELKRF	@sObject, @sObjectOrg
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg
						end
					close c_deleted

                    --poss_sdm code goes here since it is an after statement trigger
                    --I think the Oracle code intended to keep track of all of the rows 
                    --that were being updated in the loop above and then update them all here, 
                    --but that's not the way it is coded.  The wya it is actually coded, Oracle 
                    --only keeps track of the last row updated and runs this section of code
                    --against it here
					execute @nReturn = dbo.O7UPDKRF	@sObject, @sObjectOrg
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_deleted
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

  declare @sWOCheckresult nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
  declare @nReturn        int
  declare @nWOReturn      int
  declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
  declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)
  declare @sCasemanagement   nvarchar(30)

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare c_deleted cursor local for select tcm_code, tcm_casemanagement from deleted
      set @sX = NULL
      set @sOrg = NULL
      set @sCheckresult = N'0'

      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          open c_deleted 
          fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sCasemanagement
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CMTK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
              execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CATM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT

                  deallocate c_deleted

                  return

                  close c_deleted
                  deallocate c_deleted
                  execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                  execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sWOCheckresult, @@ERROR
                  rollback transaction
                  return

            end

create trigger POSDEL_TOR
on R5TOOLREQ
for delete
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent         	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer  
	declare @sEventRstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEventRtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParentEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sEventOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dEventInterface	datetime
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)  
        declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4) 

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select TOR_EVENT from deleted
			
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							
							/*************************************************
							  Databridge workorder outbound event
							*************************************************/
							select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
							from r5install
							where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

							if @sFlag = N'A'
							begin
								select	@sEventRstatus = evt_rstatus,
									@sEventRtype = evt_rtype,
									@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
									@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
									@sEventOrg = evt_org,
									@dEventInterface = evt_interface
								from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

								if (@sEventRtype = N'JOB' or @sEventRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sEventRstatus = N'C' or @sEventRstatus = N'R') 
								begin
									select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
									from r5ucodes
									where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
									if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dEventInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dEventInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end
							
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select TOU_EVENT from deleted
			
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							
							/*************************************************
							  Databridge workorder outbound event
							*************************************************/
							select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
							from r5install
							where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

							if @sFlag = N'A'
							begin
								select	@sEventRstatus = evt_rstatus,
									@sEventRtype = evt_rtype,
									@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
									@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
									@sEventOrg = evt_org,
									@dEventInterface = evt_interface
								from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

								if (@sEventRtype = N'JOB' or @sEventRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sEventRstatus = N'C' or @sEventRstatus = N'R') 
								begin
									select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
									from r5ucodes
									where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
									if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dEventInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dEventInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end

							/* Flag WO as to recalculate costs. */
							UPDATE r5eventcost
							SET    evo_recalccost = N'+', evo_costcalculated = N'-'
							WHERE  evo_event = @sEvent
							AND    ISNULL( evo_recalccost, N'-' ) <> N'+'
							
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger POSDEL_TRD
on R5TRADES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(15)	
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select TRD_CODE, TRD_ORG from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* W45401 - Delete dependant data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'TRAD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCITM'
							
							if @nCount > 0 
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCITM'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'

							if @sFlag = N'T'
								begin
													
									EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

										
									INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
									(XTS_TRANTYPE,
									XTS_TABLE,
									XTS_KEYFLD1,
									XTS_KEYFLD2,
									XTS_KEYFLD3,
									XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
									XTS_ORG
									)
									VALUES(N'SYNCITEM',
									N'R5TRADES',
									@sCode,
									@sOrg,
									N'D',
									@sTempMsgid,
									@sOrg)
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end
