CREATE TRIGGER POSDEL_TSC
  ON r5templatesalesprice
  FOR DELETE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sTscContractTemplate	     	NVARCHAR(50)
  DECLARE @sTscContractTemplateOrg     	NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sTscPk     		NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sTscRentity        	NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @sTscCode	     	NVARCHAR(50)
  DECLARE @nTscSalesprice 		NUMERIC(24,6)  
  DECLARE @sTscStore        	NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sTscOrg     		NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @dTscStartDate   DATETIME
  DECLARE @dTscEndDate     DATETIME
  DECLARE @sUser          	NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @dMinfromdate   	DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxfromdate   	DATETIME

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT tsc_pk, tsc_contracttemplate, tsc_contracttemplate_org, tsc_rentity, tsc_code, tsc_org, 
             tsc_salesprice, tsc_startdate, tsc_enddate, tsc_store
      FROM   DELETED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_deleted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sTscPk, @sTscContractTemplate, @sTscContractTemplateOrg, @sTscRentity, @sTscCode, @sTscOrg,  
                 @nTscSalesprice,   @dTscStartDate, @dTscEndDate, @sTscStore
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SELECT @dMaxfromdate = MAX(tsc_startdate) 
              FROM   r5templatesalesprice
              WHERE  tsc_contracttemplate	=	@sTscContractTemplate
              AND	 tsc_contracttemplate_org	=	@sTscContractTemplateOrg
              AND	 tsc_rentity    =	@sTscRentity
              AND    tsc_org 		= 	@sTscOrg
              AND    ISNULL(tsc_store,'')  	=	ISNULL(@sTscStore,'')
              AND    tsc_startdate   < @dTscStartDate;
              IF @dMaxfromdate IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @dMinfromdate = MIN(tsc_startdate) - 1
                  FROM   r5templatesalesprice
                  WHERE  tsc_contracttemplate	=	@sTscContractTemplate
                  AND	 tsc_contracttemplate_org	=	@sTscContractTemplateOrg
                  AND	 tsc_rentity    =	@sTscRentity
                  AND    tsc_org 	= @sTscOrg
                  AND    ISNULL(tsc_store,'')  = ISNULL(@sTscStore,'')
                  AND    tsc_startdate   > @dTscStartDate
                  SET @dMinfromdate = ISNULL( @dMinfromdate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

                  UPDATE r5templatesalesprice
                  SET    tsc_enddate     = @dMinfromdate
                  WHERE  tsc_contracttemplate	=	@sTscContractTemplate
                  AND	 tsc_contracttemplate_org	=	@sTscContractTemplateOrg
                  AND	 tsc_rentity    =	@sTscRentity
                  AND    tsc_org 	= @sTscOrg
                  AND    ISNULL(tsc_store,'')  = ISNULL(@sTscStore,'')
                  AND    tsc_startdate   = @dMaxfromdate
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @sTscPk, @sTscContractTemplate, @sTscContractTemplateOrg, @sTscRentity, @sTscCode, @sTscOrg,  
                 	@nTscSalesprice,   @dTscStartDate, @dTscEndDate, @sTscStore
            END
          CLOSE c_deleted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

create trigger POSDEL_TSK
on R5TASKS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nRevision		numeric(4)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sIsJobPlan		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sEntity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(64)
	declare @nWOReturn		int
	declare @sWOCheckresult nvarchar(4)
	declare @nTHReturn		int
	declare @nTL1Return		int
	declare @nTL2Return		int
	declare @nTL3Return		int
	declare @nTL4Return		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select TSK_CODE, TSK_REVISION, TSK_ORG, TSK_JOBPLAN from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @nRevision, @sOrg, @sIsJobPlan
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
						
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sWOCheckresult = N'0'
							if @sIsJobPlan = N'+' set @sEntity = N'JBPL'
							else set @sEntity = N'TASK'

							/* W2343 -  Delete dependant data */
							set @sConcat = @sCode + N'#' + cast( @nRevision as nvarchar(38))
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, @sEntity, @sX, N'*', @sConcat, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'TASW', @sX, N'*', @sConcat, @sOrg, @sX, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
							
							/* Long Descriptions for Permit To Work Tags */
							execute @nTHReturn  = O7LONGDESCS N'DEL', N'TGHD', @sConcat, null
							execute @nTL1Return = O7LONGDESCS N'DEL', N'TGL1', @sConcat, null
							execute @nTL2Return = O7LONGDESCS N'DEL', N'TGL2', @sConcat, null
							execute @nTL3Return = O7LONGDESCS N'DEL', N'TGL3', @sConcat, null
							execute @nTL4Return = O7LONGDESCS N'DEL', N'TGL4', @sConcat, null   
							
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0 or @nTHReturn <> 0 or @nTL1Return <> 0 or @nTL2Return <> 0 or @nTL3Return <> 0 or @nTL4Return <> 0
								begin

													  	REI_DATE,	REI_READING,	REI_OBTYPE,	REI_OBRTYPE,	REI_OBJECT,
													  	REI_DIFF,	REI_UOM,	REI_CALCUOM,	REI_RECORDED,	REI_TRANS,
													  	REI_SESSIONID,	REI_TRANSORGID,	REI_TRANSGROUP,	REI_OBJECT_ORG,	REI_USER,
													  	REI_ORG,	REI_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@nTransid,	@dCreated,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@sMeter,
												   	@dDate,	@nReading,	@sObtype,	@sObrtype,	@sObject,
												   	@nDiff,	@sUom,	@sCalcuom,	@dRecorded,	@sTrans,

												   	@sOrg,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return

								begin

									rollback transaction
									return

														   	@sOrg,	@nSqlidentity
						end

				end

ON R5FAILURES
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_inserted cursor local for select FAL_CODE from inserted
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'

        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin

            fetch next from c_inserted into @FAL_CODE
        End
        Close c_inserted
    End
    deallocate c_inserted

name: POSINS3_TRL
body:
CREATE TRIGGER POSINS3_TRL
ON R5TRANSLINES
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
declare @sUser  nvarchar(38)
declare @sKey  nvarchar(400)
declare @sValue  nvarchar(400)
declare @TRL_LINE numeric
declare @TRL_TRANS nvarchar(30)

declare @sFlag				nvarchar(6)
declare @sFlag2				nvarchar(6)
declare @sXmlFromrentity		nvarchar(4)
declare @sXmlTorentity			nvarchar(4)
declare @sXmlSourcesystem		nvarchar(45)
declare @sXmlSourcecode			nvarchar(45)
declare @sTraRstatus			nvarchar(4)
declare @sTraOrg			nvarchar(15)
declare @sRtype              		nvarchar(4)
declare @sOrder              		nvarchar(30)
declare @nReturn			int
declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)


if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_inserted cursor local for select TRL_LINE,TRL_TRANS,TRL_RTYPE,TRL_ORDER from inserted
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
        open c_inserted
        fetch next from c_inserted into @TRL_LINE,@TRL_TRANS,@sRtype,@sOrder
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            select @sKey = 'TRL_LINE' + CHAR(13) + 'TRL_TRANS'
            select @sValue = str(@TRL_LINE) + CHAR(13) + @TRL_TRANS
            execute o7mobile_sync_event N'R5TRANSLINES', N'INSERT', @sKey, @sValue, NULL

	    --databridge xmlout_posins_trl
	    set @sFlag = N'N'

	    select @sFlag = isnull( ins_desc, N'N' ) from r5install where ins_code = N'@UPDINV'

	    if upper( @sFlag ) = N'Y' OR upper(@sFlag) = 'E'
		begin
			select @sXmlFromrentity = tra_fromrentity,
				@sXmlTorentity = tra_torentity,
				@sTraRstatus = tra_rstatus,
				@sTraOrg = tra_org,
				@sXmlSourcesystem = tra_sourcesystem,
				@sXmlSourcecode = tra_sourcecode
			from r5transactions where tra_code = @TRL_TRANS

			if @sRtype = N'I' and not ( @sXmlFromrentity = N'STOR' and @sXmlTorentity = N'STOR' )
			OR ( upper(@sFlag) = N'E'  AND	( @sRtype = N'STTK'
							  OR (@sRtype = N'RECV' AND @sOrder IS NULL AND @sXmlFromrentity = N'COMP' AND @sXmlTorentity = N'STOR')
							  OR (@sRtype = N'I' AND @sXmlFromrentity = N'STOR' AND @sXmlTorentity = N'STOR')
							  OR @sRtype = N'CORR'
							)
			   )
			AND @sXmlSourcesystem is null and @sXmlSourcecode is null and @sTraRstatus = N'A'
				begin
					EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_inserted
							deallocate c_inserted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end


					INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
						(XTS_TRANTYPE,
						XTS_TABLE,
						XTS_KEYFLD1,
						XTS_KEYFLD2,
						XTS_ORG,
						XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
						VALUES
						(N'UPDINV',
						N'R5TRANSLINES',
						@TRL_TRANS,
						cast(@TRL_LINE as nvarchar),
						@sTraOrg,
						@sTempMsgid			
						)
				end
		end

		if upper( @sFlag ) = N'A'
			begin
				set @sFlag2 = N'N'
				select @sFlag2 = isnull( ins_desc, N'N' ) from r5install where ins_code = N'@UPINVRR'
									
				select @sXmlFromrentity = tra_fromrentity,
					@sXmlTorentity = tra_torentity,
					@sTraRstatus = tra_rstatus,
					@sTraOrg = tra_org
				from r5transactions where tra_code = @TRL_TRANS

				if @sTraRstatus = N'A'
				AND (   (@sRtype = N'I' AND @sXmlFromrentity = N'STOR')
					OR (@sRtype = N'RR' AND @sXmlFromrentity = N'STOR' AND @sFlag2 = N'Y')
					OR (@sRtype = N'STTK' AND @sXmlFromrentity = N'STOR')
					OR (@sRtype = N'RECV' AND @sOrder IS NULL AND @sXmlTorentity = N'STOR')
				    )
					begin
						EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							begin
								close c_inserted
								deallocate c_inserted
								rollback transaction
								return
							end

						INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
							(XTS_TRANTYPE,
							XTS_TABLE,
							XTS_KEYFLD1,
							XTS_KEYFLD2,
							XTS_ORG,
							XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
							VALUES
							(N'UPDINV',
							N'R5TRANSLINES',
							@TRL_TRANS,
							cast(@TRL_LINE as nvarchar),
							@sTraOrg,
							@sTempMsgid
							)
					end
			end

            fetch next from c_inserted into @TRL_LINE,@TRL_TRANS,@sRtype,@sOrder
        End
        Close c_inserted
    End
    deallocate c_inserted
End

create trigger POSINSUPD_DIM
on R5DWDIMENSIONS
for insert, update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(4) 
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					set @sTemp = N'INS'
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select DIM_TABLE, DIM_DESC from inserted 
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sTemp = N'UPD'
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.DIM_TABLE, i.DIM_DESC
														from inserted i, deleted d
														where i.DIM_SQLIDENTITY = d.DIM_SQLIDENTITY
				end

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sTable, @sDesc
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null



							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS @sTemp, @sX, N'DWDI', @sX, N'*', @sTable, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sTable, @sDesc
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger POSINSUPD_EEV
on R5EQUIPEVALUATIONS
for insert, update, delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nSQLIdentityID			int

	--The Following Trigger Combines the following 3 triggers into 1:
	-- POSINS_EEV
	-- POSUPD_EEV
	-- POSDEL_EEV

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				--INSERTING
				begin
					declare c_inserted cursor local for select	EEV_CODE, EEV_ORG, EEV_SQLIDENTITY, EEV_DESC	from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @nSQLIdentityID, @sDesc
							
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									set @nCountit = 0
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									set @sX = NULL							

									
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'EEVL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
																											
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @nSQLIdentityID, @sDesc
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
				end
			else
				--UPDATING
				begin
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.EEV_CODE, i.EEV_ORG, i.EEV_DESC, d.EEV_CODE, d.EEV_ORG, i.EEV_SQLIDENTITY		from inserted i, deleted d	where	i.EEV_SQLIDENTITY = d.EEV_SQLIDENTITY
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_ins_del 
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @nSQLIdentityID

							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									
									--AFTER EACH ROW portion

									if @sUser <> N'SYS'
										begin
											set @sCheckresult = N'0'
											set @sX = null
											execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'EEVL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end 
																							
									fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @nSQLIdentityID
								end
							close c_ins_del
						end
					deallocate c_ins_del
				end
		end

create trigger POSINSUPD_FFL
on R5DWFACTFIELDS
for insert, update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sField			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(4) 
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					set @sTemp = N'INS'
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select FFL_FIELD, FFL_DESC from inserted 				end
			else
				begin
					set @sTemp = N'UPD'
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.FFL_FIELD, i.FFL_DESC
														from inserted i, deleted d
														where i.FFL_SQLIDENTITY = d.FFL_SQLIDENTITY
				end

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sField, @sDesc
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS @sTemp, @sX, N'DWFF', @sX, N'*', @sField, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sField, @sDesc
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger posins_:prefix on :srctable for insert as insert into :srcexttable (:prefix_uprecnum, :prefix_upcode) select :prefix_uprecnum, :prefix_upcode from inserted go'
    set @sSrcexttable = dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename( @sSrctable )

    declare c_c1 cursor local for SELECT ded_newextfield,
                                         (CASE WHEN a.data_type = N'NVARCHAR' THEN a.data_type + N'(' + cast(data_length as nvarchar(38)) + N')' WHEN a.data_type = N'NUMERIC' AND a.data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN a.data_type + N'(' + cast(a.data_precision as nvarchar(38)) + N',' + cast(coalesce(a.data_scale,0) as nvarchar(38)) + N')' ELSE a.data_type END),
                                         dct_desttableprefix,
                                         b.tablespace_name,
                                         d.tablespace_name
                                    FROM user_tab_columns a, user_tables b, user_constraints c, user_indexes d, r5dataconvextdef, r5dataconvlist
                                   WHERE dct_srcproductid = @nPid
                                     AND dct_desttable = @sSrctable
                                     AND ded_srcproductid = dct_srcproductid
                                     AND ded_srctable = dct_desttable
                                     AND ded_srcfields = N'-'
                                     AND a.table_name = ded_reftable
                                     AND a.column_name = ded_reffields
                                     AND b.table_name = a.table_name
                                     AND c.constraint_type = N'P'
                                     AND c.table_name = b.table_name
                                     AND d.table_name = c.table_name
                                     AND d.index_name = c.constraint_name
                                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                            FROM user_tab_columns
                                           WHERE table_name = dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename(@sSrctable)
                                             AND column_name = ded_newextfield)
                                  UNION
                                  SELECT a.ded_newextfield, b.syntax, dct_desttableprefix,
                                         c.tablespace_name, e.tablespace_name
                                    FROM r5dataconvextdef a, (SELECT ded_srcproductid, ded_srctable, ded_reffields, (CASE WHEN data_type = 'NVARCHAR' THEN data_type + N'(' + cast(data_length as nvarchar(38)) + N')' WHEN data_type = 'NUMERIC' AND data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN data_type + N'(' + cast(data_precision as nvarchar(38)) + N',' + cast(coalesce(data_scale, 0) as nvarchar(38)) + N')' ELSE data_type END)
                                                                FROM user_tab_columns, r5dataconvextdef
                                                               WHERE ded_srcfields = N'-'
                                                                 AND table_name = ded_reftable
                                                                 AND column_name = ded_reffields) b, r5dataconvlist, user_tables c, user_constraints d, user_indexes e
                                   WHERE dct_srcproductid = @nPid
                                     AND dct_desttable = @sSrctable
                                     AND a.ded_srcproductid = dct_srcproductid
                                     AND a.ded_srctable = dct_desttable
                                     AND a.ded_srcfields <> N'-'
                                     AND a.ded_srcproductid = b.ded_srcproductid
                                     AND a.ded_reftable = b.ded_srctable
                                     AND a.ded_refextfield = b.ded_reffields
                                     AND c.table_name = dct_desttable
                                     AND d.constraint_type = N'P'
                                     AND d.table_name = c.table_name
                                     AND e.table_name = d.table_name
                                     AND e.index_name = d.constraint_name
                                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                            FROM user_tab_columns
                                           WHERE table_name = dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename(@sSrctable)
                                             AND column_name = ded_newextfield)
                                   ORDER BY 1
    open c_c1
    fetch next from c_c1 into @sNewextfield, @sSyntax, @sPrefix, @sDatatablespace, @sIndextablespace
    while @@fetch_status = 0
        begin
            set @sExistssql = N'select @count = count(*) from SYSOBJECTS where NAME = ''' + @sSrcexttable + N''' and TYPE = ''U'''
            execute @nReturn = sp_executesql @sExistssql, N'@count int OUTPUT', @nCount OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_c1
                    deallocate c_c1
                    return -1
                end

            if @nCount = 0
                begin
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql_template,    N':srcexttable',        @sSrcexttable)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':prefix',             @sPrefix)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':fieldname',          @sNewextfield)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':fieldsyntax',        @sSyntax)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':srctable',           @sSrctable)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':indextablespace',    @sIndextablespace)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':datatablespace',     @sDatatablespace)
                    exec (@sCreatesql)
                    if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_c1
                            deallocate c_c1
                            return -1
                        end

                    set @sTriggersql = REPLACE(@sTriggersql_template, ':srcexttable', @sSrcexttable)
                    set @sTriggersql = REPLACE(@sTriggersql, ':prefix', @sPrefix)
                    set @sTriggersql = REPLACE(@sTriggersql, ':srctable', @sSrctable)
                    exec (@sTriggersql)
                    if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_c1

create trigger POSINS_ACK
on r5actchecklists
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser                 nvarchar(38)
    declare @sEvent                  nvarchar(30)
	declare @sAct                  numeric(8)
    declare @nReturn               int
    declare @sLoto                 nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCasetask             nvarchar(30)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_inserted cursor local for select ack_event, ack_act, ack_loto, ack_casetask from inserted
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_inserted 
                    fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent, @sAct, @sLoto, @sCasetask
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
							if @sAct = 0
								begin
									/* Reset Permit To Work esignature information. */
									UPDATE r5permittowork SET ptw_reviewed = null, ptw_reviewedby = null, ptw_reviewedtype = null WHERE ptw_code = @sEvent AND @sLoto IS NOT NULL;
									/* Reset Case Management esignature information. */
                                    UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null WHERE csm_code = @sEvent AND @sCasetask IS NOT NULL;                             
								end
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                            fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent, @sAct, @sLoto, @sCasetask
                        end
                    close c_inserted
                end
            deallocate c_inserted
        end

                        end

                           if CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) > 0

                                            AND    evt_updated NOT BETWEEN @dGetdate - .00005 AND @dGetdate + .00005


                                 fetch next from c_eventcursor into @sPevEvent
                              end   
                            close c_eventcursor
                            deallocate c_eventcursor
                        end

create trigger POSINS_AQU
on R5ACTQUALIFICATIONS
for insert NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nAct         		numeric(8,0)
	declare @sQualification   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sSource        	nvarchar(1)        
	declare @sRemoved   	    nvarchar(1)
	declare @nUpdatecount 		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 		integer
	
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @nReturn		integer

	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRtype			nvarchar(4)
	
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParentEvent	nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sEventOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dInterface		datetime

	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)
	declare @sKey  			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sValue  		nvarchar(400)
	declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	AQU_EVENT,	AQU_ACTIVITY,	AQU_QUALIFICATION,	AQU_SOURCE,	AQU_REMOVED,
													  	AQU_UPDATECOUNT,	AQU_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@sQualification,	@sSource,	@sRemoved,
													@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							/**************************************************************************
							
							The following code is for Databridge work order outbound event
							
							**************************************************************************/
							select	@sRstatus = evt_rstatus,
									@sRtype = evt_rtype,
									@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
									@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
									@sEventOrg = evt_org,
									@dInterface = evt_interface
							from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

							if (@sRtype = N'JOB' or @sRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sRstatus = N'C' or @sRstatus = N'R') 
							begin

								select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
								from r5install
								where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

								if @sFlag = N'A'
								begin
								    select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
								    from r5ucodes
								    where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
								    if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin

										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sFlag = N'A' and @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end

													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'

create trigger POSINS_AVA
on R5AUDVALUES FOR INSERT
as
	declare @sUsr_name		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nSeqnum		int
	declare @dCreate		datetime
	declare @sTrantype		nvarchar(16)
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(32)
	declare @sKeyfld1		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld2		nvarchar(200)
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	AVA_TABLE, AVA_PRIMARYID, AVA_SECONDARYID, AVA_DELETED from inserted
			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sTable, @sKeyfld1,@sKeyfld2,@sFlag
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin
							--xmlout portion
							if @nSeqnum is null or @nSeqnum = 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nSeqnum OUTPUT, N'DKD', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
									set @dCreate = GETUTCDATE()
								end

						end
						
						if  @sFlag = N'+'
							INSERT INTO R5DATALAKEDELETE (DKD_SEQNUM, DKD_TABLE, DKD_KEYFLD1, DKD_KEYFLD2) 
							SELECT @nSeqnum, @sTable, @sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2  FROM DUAL where NOT EXISTS 
							(SELECT 1 FROM R5DATALAKEDELETE WHERE DKD_TABLE = @sTable and DKD_KEYFLD1 =  @sKeyfld1 and DKD_KEYFLD2 = @sKeyfld2)
						
						fetch next from c_inserted into @sTable, @sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2, @sFlag
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

              IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'

                  CLOSE c_inserted

                  EXECUTE O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                  RETURN
                END
                
				execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno1 OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT

				execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

					deallocate c_inserted
					rollback transaction
					return

				execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT

				execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg

create trigger POSINS_CEV
on R5CALCEVENTS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nIncrement    	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sStatus       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sDebtor       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sAgreement    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nLab_cost     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMat_cost     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nPrice        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sIncrementable	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dDate         	datetime            
	declare @sOrigin       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nHir_cost     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nDma_cost     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nFix_cost     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCost         	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nLab_calc     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMat_calc     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nHir_calc     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nDma_calc     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nFix_calc     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nAdd_calc     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCalc         	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nFix_corr     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nLab_corr     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMat_corr     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nHir_corr     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nDma_corr     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nAdd_corr     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCorr         	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nFix_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nLab_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMat_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nHir_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nDma_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nAdd_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nTol_cost     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nTol_calc     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nTol_corr     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nTol_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nUpdatecount  	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity  	integer             

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDflang		nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sCevDesc		nvarchar(80)	--r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE
	declare @bReturn		bit
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(48)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	CEV_EVENT,	CEV_INCREMENT,	CEV_STATUS,	CEV_RSTATUS,	CEV_DEBTOR,
													  	CEV_AGREEMENT,	CEV_LAB_COST,	CEV_MAT_COST,	CEV_PRICE,	CEV_INCREMENTABLE,
													  	CEV_DATE,	CEV_ORIGIN,	CEV_HIR_COST,	CEV_DMA_COST,	CEV_FIX_COST,
													  	CEV_COST,	CEV_LAB_CALC,	CEV_MAT_CALC,	CEV_HIR_CALC,	CEV_DMA_CALC,
													  	CEV_FIX_CALC,	CEV_ADD_CALC,	CEV_CALC,	CEV_FIX_CORR,	CEV_LAB_CORR,
													  	CEV_MAT_CORR,	CEV_HIR_CORR,	CEV_DMA_CORR,	CEV_ADD_CORR,	CEV_CORR,
													  	CEV_FIX_PRICE,	CEV_LAB_PRICE,	CEV_MAT_PRICE,	CEV_HIR_PRICE,	CEV_DMA_PRICE,
													  	CEV_ADD_PRICE,	CEV_TOL_COST,	CEV_TOL_CALC,	CEV_TOL_CORR,	CEV_TOL_PRICE,
													  	CEV_UPDATECOUNT,	CEV_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEvent,	@nIncrement,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sDebtor,
														@sAgreement,	@nLab_cost,	@nMat_cost,	@nPrice,	@sIncrementable,
														@dDate,	@sOrigin,	@nHir_cost,	@nDma_cost,	@nFix_cost,
														@nCost,	@nLab_calc,	@nMat_calc,	@nHir_calc,	@nDma_calc,
														@nFix_calc,	@nAdd_calc,	@nCalc,	@nFix_corr,	@nLab_corr,
														@nMat_corr,	@nHir_corr,	@nDma_corr,	@nAdd_corr,	@nCorr,
														@nFix_price,	@nLab_price,	@nMat_price,	@nHir_price,	@nDma_price,
														@nAdd_price,	@nTol_cost,	@nTol_calc,	@nTol_corr,	@nTol_price,
														@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--posins_cev portion
							select @sDflang = ins_desc from r5install where ins_code = N'DEFLANG'
							set @sCevDesc = dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC( @sDflang, N'EVNT', @sEvent, null, null )

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', null, N'CEV', null, N'*', @sEvent, null, @sCevDesc, @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--o7poscev portion
							set @sConcat = @sEvent + cast( @nIncrement + 1 as nvarchar )
							execute @nReturn = O7CEV_EXISTSMORE @bReturn OUTPUT, @sConcat, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @bReturn = 1
								begin
									if @sIncrementable is null
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7POSCEV', N'PROC', 56
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sStatus not in ( N'I', N'A', N'E' )
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7POSCEV', N'PROC', 57
											rollback transaction

	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)

	declare @sRentitycode		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sNotused			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select CLS_CODE, CLS_ORG, CLS_RENTITY, CLS_RENTITYCODE, CLS_DESC, CLS_NOTUSED from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sRentity, @sRentitycode, @sDesc, @sNotused
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CLAS', @sRentitycode, @sRentity, @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							-- add Databridge event to r5xmltranstatus table
							if @sRentity = N'EVNT'
							begin
								SELECT @sFlag = isnull(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

									begin
										close c_inserted

									VALUES

								end
							end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sRentity, @sRentitycode, @sDesc, @sNotused
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

as

	declare @sMfgmatchflag	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOrg         	nvarchar(15)

	declare @sClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer   
	declare @dLastsaved 	datetime
	
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChk1			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int

	declare @sGetStype		nvarchar(8)

	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sCertnum			nvarchar(20)	--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certification%TYPE
	declare @sCerttype			nvarchar(8)		--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certificationtype%TYPE
	          

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	CNH_CODE,	CNH_MANUFACT,	CNH_STATUS,	CNH_RSTATUS,		CNH_STARTDATE,
									CNH_EXPIREDATE,	CNH_CLASS,	CNH_DESC,	CNH_MFGMATCHFLAG,	CNH_ORG,
									CNH_CLOSEDATE,	CNH_CLASS_ORG,	CNH_UPDATECOUNT,CNH_SQLIDENTITY,	CNH_LASTSAVED
							from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,		@sManufact,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@dStartdate,
									   	@dExpiredate,	@sClass,	@sDesc,		@sMfgmatchflag,	@sOrg,
									   	@dClosedate,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,	@dLastsaved
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--POSINS 
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null


							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CHNO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							
							execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'DEL', N'CHNO', @sStatus, N'-'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nErecord > 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									
									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYNUM @sCertnum OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYTYPE @sCerttype OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

								
									INSERT INTO r5elecarchive (  ELA_CODE, ELA_USER,  ELA_DATE,  ELA_SIGNTYPE, ELA_CERTIFYNUM, ELA_CERTIFYTYPE,
																  ELA_SCODE, ELA_ENTITY,ELA_ENTCODE,ELA_ENTORG,   ELA_STATUS, ELA_PARENT,
																  ELA_FLD1,  ELA_FLD2,   ELA_FLD3,   ELA_FLD4,
																  ELA_FLD5,  ELA_FLD6,   ELA_FLD7,   ELA_FLD8,
																  ELA_FLD9,  ELA_FLD10,  ELA_FLD11,  ELA_FLD12,
																  ELA_FLD13, ELA_FLD14 )
									VALUES ( @sSeqno,	@sGetUser,	@dGtTime,	@sGetStype, @sCertnum, @sCerttype,
										  null,    N'CHNO',          @sCode,       @sOrg, @sStatus,     null,
										  @sCode,	@sManufact,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	
										  cast(@dStartdate as nvarchar(30)),
										  cast(@dExpiredate as nvarchar(30)),
										  @sClass,	@sDesc,	@sMfgmatchflag,	@sOrg,
										  cast(@dClosedate as nvarchar(30)),@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
										  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dLastsaved, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') )

							end
							fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,		@sManufact,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@dStartdate,
												@dExpiredate,	@sClass,	@sDesc,		@sMfgmatchflag,	@sOrg,
												@dClosedate,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity, 	@dLastsaved
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_CRH

as

  declare @nReturn              int

  declare @sOrg                 nvarchar(15)
  declare @dDate                datetime
  declare @sEventType           nvarchar(4)
  declare @sUserCode            nvarchar(255)
  declare @sField               nvarchar(45)
  declare @sOldValue            nvarchar(250)
  declare @sNewValue            nvarchar(250)
  declare @nUpdateCnt           numeric(38)
  declare @sComment             nvarchar(2000)
  declare @nSQLIdentity         int
  declare @sEvent               nvarchar(30)
  declare @sRentity             nvarchar(4)

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON

      declare c_inserted cursor local for 
        select CRH_PK,CRH_CALLCENTERCODE,CRH_CALLCENTER_ORG,CRH_REQDATE,CRH_EVENTTYPE,CRH_USERCODE,
        CRH_FIELD,CRH_OLDVALUE,CRH_NEWVALUE,CRH_UPDATECOUNT,CRH_COMMENT,CRH_SQLIDENTITY,CRH_EVENT,CRH_RENTITY
        from inserted
      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          open c_inserted

            @sPK,@sCallCenterCode,@sOrg,@dDate,@sEventType,@sUserCode,
            @sField,@sOldValue,@sNewValue,@nUpdateCnt,@sComment,@nSQLIdentity,@sEvent,@sRentity
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
		      select @nCount = count(*) from R5INSTALL where INS_CODE = N'@EVNTLOG'

		            begin
		              close c_inserted
		              deallocate c_inserted
		              rollback transaction
		              return
		            end
		            
		          INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS( XTS_TRANTYPE, XTS_TABLE, XTS_KEYFLD1,XTS_ORG, XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID )
		          VALUES( N'EVENTLOG', N'R5CUSTOMERREQUESTHISTORY', @sPK, @sOrg, @sTempMsgid )
		        end

                @sField,@sOldValue,@sNewValue,@nUpdateCnt,@sComment,@nSQLIdentity,@sEvent,@sRentity
            end
          close c_inserted
        end
      deallocate c_inserted
    end

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @nIdentity, @dIssuedate, @dReturndate, @sRtype, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sReturnedObj, @sReturnedObj_org
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CREN', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @nAcd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							update r5customerrentals
							set crt_acd = @nAcd
							where crt_sqlidentity = @nIdentity
							
							SET @sParams = '@cnt INT OUTPUT, @issue_date DATETIME, @return_date DATETIME, @obj NVARCHAR(30), @obj_org NVARCHAR(15), @crt_id NVARCHAR(50)'
                            SET @sSql = 'SELECT @cnt = count(*) FROM r5customerrentals
                                WHERE crt_rstatus  <> ''C''
                                AND ((@issue_date  >= (DATEADD(minute, -COALESCE(crt_travelfrom, 0), DATEADD(minute, -COALESCE(crt_setuptime, 0), crt_estimatedissuedate))) AND
                                      @issue_date  <  (DATEADD(minute, COALESCE(crt_travelto, 0), DATEADD(minute, COALESCE(crt_teardowntime, 0), crt_estimatedreturndate))))
                                  OR (@return_date >  (DATEADD(minute, -COALESCE(crt_travelfrom, 0), DATEADD(minute, -COALESCE(crt_setuptime, 0), crt_estimatedissuedate))) AND
                                      @return_date <= (DATEADD(minute, COALESCE(crt_travelto, 0), DATEADD(minute, COALESCE(crt_teardowntime, 0), crt_estimatedreturndate))))
                                  OR (@issue_date  <  (DATEADD(minute, -COALESCE(crt_travelfrom, 0), DATEADD(minute, -COALESCE(crt_setuptime, 0), crt_estimatedissuedate))) AND
                                      @return_date >  (DATEADD(minute, COALESCE(crt_travelto, 0), DATEADD(minute, COALESCE(crt_teardowntime, 0), crt_estimatedreturndate)))))'
                            IF @sRtype = 'L'
                                BEGIN
                                    SET @sSql = @sSql + ' AND crt_returnedobject = @obj AND crt_returnedobject_org = @obj_org '
                                    SET @sObj = @sReturnedObj
                                    SET @sObj_org = @sReturnedObj_org
                                END
                            ELSE
                                BEGIN
                                    SET @sSql = @sSql + ' AND crt_object = @obj AND crt_object_org = @obj_org '
                                    SET @sObj = @sObject
                                    SET @sObj_org = @sObject_org
                                END
                            SET @sSql = @sSql + ' AND crt_code + ''#'' + crt_org <> @crt_id '
                            SET @sCrtID =  @sCode + '#' + @sOrg
                            SET @nCnt = 0   
                            EXEC sp_ExecuteSQL @sSql, @sParams, @cnt = @nCnt OUTPUT,
                            @issue_date = @dIssuedate, 
                            @return_date = @dReturndate, 
                            @obj = @sObj, 
                            @obj_org = @sObj_org,
                            @crt_id = @sCrtID
                            IF ( @nCnt > 0 )
                                BEGIN
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    EXEC o7rae 'PREINS_CRT', 'TRIG', '1', @@ERROR 
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                END 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @nIdentity, @dIssuedate, @dReturndate, @sRtype, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sReturnedObj, @sReturnedObj_org
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_CSM
on r5casemanagement
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser            nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX               nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sKeyCode         nvarchar(50)
    declare @sOrg             nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc            nvarchar(80)
    declare @nReturn          int
    declare @nErecord         int
    declare @sStatus          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sWODesc		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sWOCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nWOReturn		int
	declare @sCsmgmt		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid     nvarchar(256)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_inserted cursor local for select csm_code, csm_org, csm_desc, csm_status, csm_wo_desc from inserted
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_inserted 
                    fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sStatus, @sWODesc
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sWOCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sKeyCode = @sCode
                            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CASE', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                            execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CASW', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0 
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            if @sCheckresult <> N'0' or @sWOCheckresult <> N'0' 
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sWOCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                                
                            execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'INS', N'CASE', N'-', @sStatus
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
                              begin
                                close c_inserted
                                deallocate c_inserted
                                rollback transaction
                                return
                              end
              
                            if @nErecord > 0 
                              begin
                                /* Elec archive. */
                                execute @nReturn = o7csmelecarchive N'INSERT', @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                  begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                  end
                                end 
								
							--Databridge Outbound Events for EAM-32443 Start
							set @sCsmgmt = N'N'
							select @sCsmgmt = coalesce( INS_DESC, N'N' ) FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@CSMGMT'

							if upper(@sCsmgmt) = N'Y'
							  begin        
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									  begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									  end
                                            
									INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
									(    XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID, 
										XTS_ORG)
									SELECT    N'CSMGMT',
										N'R5CASEMANAGEMENT', 
										@sCode,
										@sTempMsgid,
										@sOrg 
									from DUAL
									where not exists(select 1 from R5XMLTRANSTATUS where XTS_TRANTYPE=N'CSMGMT' and XTS_TABLE=N'R5CASEMANAGEMENT' 
									and XTS_KEYFLD1=@sCode and XTS_ORG=@sOrg)

							   end   
							--Databridge Outbound Events for EAM-32443 End
							
                            fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sStatus, @sWODesc
                        end
                    close c_inserted
                end
            deallocate c_inserted
    end

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_CTR
ON R5CONTACTRECORDS
AFTER INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
As

declare @sSeqno             nvarchar(30)
declare @sContactrecordcode nvarchar(30)
declare @sContactrecordorg  nvarchar(15)    
declare @sCreatedBy         nvarchar(255)
declare @sStatus            nvarchar(4)
declare @sCreated           datetime
declare @nReturn            int
declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)
declare @sCallctr        nvarchar(80)
declare @sTempMsgid        nvarchar(256)
declare @dReqDate       datetime

if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_ins_del cursor local for select ctr_code,ctr_org,ctr_created,ctr_createdby,ctr_status from inserted

    if dbo.O7GTSUSR() <> N'SYS'
      begin
        open c_ins_del
        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sContactrecordcode,@sContactrecordorg,@sCreated,@sCreatedBy,@sStatus
        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'CRH', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
          begin
            close c_ins_del
            deallocate c_ins_del
            rollback transaction
            return
          end
        execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dReqDate OUTPUT, null
        INSERT INTO R5CUSTOMERREQUESTHISTORY(CRH_PK,CRH_CALLCENTERCODE,CRH_CALLCENTER_ORG, CRH_REQDATE, CRH_EVENTTYPE, CRH_USERCODE,CRH_FIELD, CRH_OLDVALUE, CRH_NEWVALUE,CRH_RENTITY)
        VALUES(@sSeqno,@sContactrecordcode,@sContactrecordorg,@dReqDate,N'RC',@sCreatedBy, null, null, null, N'COCT')
                            
        --Databridge Outbound Events
        set @sCallctr = N'N'
        select @sCallctr = coalesce( INS_DESC, N'N' ) FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@CALLCTR'
        
        if upper(@sCallctr) = N'Y'
          begin
            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
              begin
                close c_ins_del
                deallocate c_ins_del
                rollback transaction
                return
              end
                                            
            INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
            (    XTS_TRANTYPE,
                XTS_TABLE,
                XTS_KEYFLD1,
                XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID, 
                XTS_ORG)
            VALUES(    N'CALLCENTER',

create trigger POSINS_DAE
on R5DOCENTITIES
for insert NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser     	nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sREntity     	nvarchar(30)
	declare @dGetdate   	datetime
	declare @sUserid		nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select DAE_RENTITY,DAE_CODE from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sREntity,@sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							if @sREntity = N'EVNT'
							begin
								DELETE FROM r5eventsignature WHERE ets_event = @sCode and ets_updatecount <> -999
							end
							if @sRentity = N'PRME'
								begin
							        execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
							        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								        begin
									        close c_inserted
									        deallocate c_inserted
									        rollback transaction
									        return
								        end
									set @dGetdate = GetDate()
									UPDATE r5permevents 
									   SET pev_reviewed = null, pev_reviewedby = null, pev_reviewedname = null, pev_reviewedtype = null, pev_updated = @dGetdate, pev_updatedby = @sUserid
									 WHERE pev_code = @sCode;
									UPDATE r5events 
									   SET evt_permitreviewed = null, evt_permitreviewedby = null, evt_permitreviewedname = null, evt_permitreviewedtype = null
									 WHERE evt_code = (select pev_event from r5permevents where pev_code = @sCode);
								end
							/* Reset Permit To Work esignature information. */
							if @sRentity IN (N'PTW', N'SFWO', N'LTPW')
							begin
								UPDATE r5permittowork SET ptw_reviewed = null, ptw_reviewedby = null, ptw_reviewedtype = null WHERE ptw_code = @sCode
							end
							/* Reset Case Management esignature information. */
							if @sRentity = N'CASE'
							begin
								UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null WHERE csm_code = @sCode
							end
							
							if @sRentity = N'CMTK'
							begin
								UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null 
								WHERE csm_code = (SELECT tcm_casemanagement FROM r5casemanagementtasks 
								WHERE csm_code = tcm_casemanagement AND tcm_code = @sCode)
							end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sREntity,@sCode
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

												@nTax,	@nTaxed,	@sCurr,	@nExch,	@nExchanged,
												@dDate,	@sOrigin,	@nTaxperc,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,
												@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult	= N'0'
							set @sX				= null

							--pre_eiv
							execute @nReturn = o7preeiv  N'INS', @sX, @sX, @sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,@sX,
														@sCode, @sCurr OUTPUT, @dDate OUTPUT, @sDebtor, @nExch OUTPUT, @nExchanged OUTPUT, @sOrigin , @nPrice OUTPUT,
														@sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @nTax OUTPUT, @nTaxed OUTPUT, @nTaxperc OUTPUT, @sOrg OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							--posins_eiv
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'EIV', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, N'*', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					insert into R5EXTINVOICES(	EIV_CODE,	EIV_STATUS,	EIV_RSTATUS,	EIV_DEBTOR,	EIV_PRICE,
								              	EIV_TAX,	EIV_TAXED,	EIV_CURR,	EIV_EXCH,	EIV_EXCHANGED,
								              	EIV_DATE,	EIV_ORIGIN,	EIV_TAXPERC,	EIV_ORG,	EIV_UPDATECOUNT)
								              
								values (	@sCode,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sDebtor,	@nPrice,
											@nTax,	@nTaxed,	@sCurr,	@nExch,	@nExchanged,
											@dDate,	@sOrigin,	@nTaxperc,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount
									    
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sDebtor,	@nPrice,
														@nTax,	@nTaxed,	@sCurr,	@nExch,	@nExchanged,
														@dDate,	@sOrigin,	@nTaxperc,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,
														@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_EML
ON r5extmenulang
FOR INSERT
AS
  DECLARE @sUser  NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @sCode  NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sLang  NVARCHAR(2)
  DECLARE @sText  NVARCHAR(80)

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT eml_extmenu, eml_lang, eml_text FROM inserted
      SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN c_inserted
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sCode, @sLang, @sText
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO r5alltexts( atx_code, atx_texttype, atx_lang, atx_text )
              SELECT @sCode, N'MENU', @sLang, @sText
              FROM   dual
              WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                                FROM   r5alltexts
                                WHERE  atx_code = @sCode
                                AND    atx_texttype = N'MENU'
                                AND    atx_lang = @sLang )              
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sCode, @sLang, @sText
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

on r5entitysafety
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser       nvarchar(38)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_inserted cursor local for select ESF_SQLIDENTITY from inserted
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_inserted 
                    fetch next from c_inserted into @nIdentity
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin

                            set    esf_rentcode = esf_rentity + N'#' + esf_code
                            where  esf_sqlidentity = @nIdentity
                            fetch next from c_inserted into @nIdentity
                        end
                    close c_inserted
                end
            deallocate c_inserted
        end

create trigger POSINS_FAL
on R5FAILURES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select FAL_CODE, FAL_DESC from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'FAIL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_FIN
on r5fuelinventory
for insert
as
	declare @sUser          nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn        int
	declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDesc          nvarchar(200)
    declare @sDepot         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDepot_org     nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTank          nvarchar(30)
    declare @nQty           numeric(24,6)
    declare @nLine          int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select fin_code, fin_desc, fin_depot, fin_depot_org from inserted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sDepot, @sDepot_org
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'FINV', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @nLine = 0
							declare c_tank cursor local for 
								SELECT tan_code, isnull( tan_qty, 0 ) 
								FROM   r5tanks
								WHERE  tan_depot     = @sDepot
								AND    tan_depot_org = @sDepot_org
								AND    tan_notused   = N'-'


							open c_tank

							fetch next from c_tank into @sTank, @nQty
							while @@fetch_status = 0
								begin
									set @nLine = @nLine + 1
									INSERT INTO r5fuelinventorytanks( fit_fuelinventory, fit_line, fit_tank, fit_expqty )
									VALUES( @sCode, @nLine, @sTank, @nQty )
									fetch next from c_tank into @sTank, @nQty
								end
							close c_tank
							deallocate c_tank
                            
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sDepot, @sDepot_org
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_FLR
on R5FUELRECEIPTS
for insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDepot       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDepot_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sTank        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sFuel        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @dDate        	datetime            
	declare @nQty         	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nPrice       	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sSupplier    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sSupplier_org	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sReference   	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer             

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	FLR_CODE,	FLR_DEPOT,	FLR_DEPOT_ORG,	FLR_TANK,	FLR_FUEL,
													  	FLR_DATE,	FLR_QTY,	FLR_PRICE,	FLR_SUPPLIER,	FLR_SUPPLIER_ORG,
													  	FLR_REFERENCE,	FLR_UPDATECOUNT,	FLR_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDepot,	@sDepot_org,	@sTank,	@sFuel,
														@dDate,	@nQty,	@nPrice,	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,
														@sReference,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							UPDATE r5tanks
							SET	tan_qty	= round(coalesce( tan_qty, 0 ) + @nQty,6),
								tan_avgprice = CASE SIGN( coalesce( tan_qty, 0 ) + @nQty ) WHEN 1 THEN
									round(cast(dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER((cast(coalesce(tan_qty,0) * coalesce(tan_avgprice,0) as numeric(24,6)) +
											cast(@nQty * coalesce( coalesce( @nPrice, tan_avgprice ), 0 ) as numeric(24,6))),0) as numeric(24,6)) /
											cast((coalesce(tan_qty,0) + @nQty) as numeric(24,6)),6) ELSE tan_avgprice END
							WHERE	tan_depot		= @sDepot
							AND		tan_depot_org	= @sDepot_org
							AND		tan_code		= @sTank

							fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDepot,	@sDepot_org,	@sTank,	@sFuel,
																@dDate,	@nQty,	@nPrice,	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,
																@sReference,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_FUB
ON r5functionusertabs
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sUser       nvarchar(38)
  DECLARE @sFunction   nvarchar(6)
  DECLARE @sTab        nvarchar(6)
  DECLARE @sType       nvarchar(1)

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT fub_function, fub_tab, fub_type FROM inserted
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN c_inserted
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sFunction, @sTab, @sType
            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
              BEGIN
                IF @sType = 'H'
                  BEGIN
                     -- Get the key fields for the parent screen
                     INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_tab, url_parametername, url_system)
                     SELECT url_userfunction, @sTab, url_parametername, url_system
                     FROM   r5urlparameters
                     WHERE  url_userfunction = @sFunction
                     AND    url_tab = 'HDR'
                     AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1  FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab)
                     -- System params for all custom tabs
                     INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_tab, url_parametername, url_system)
                     SELECT DISTINCT @sFunction, @sTab, 'eamid', '+'
                     FROM   r5urlparameters
                     WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab AND url_parametername = 'eamid')
                     INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_tab, url_parametername, url_system)
                     SELECT DISTINCT @sFunction, @sTab, 'internal_eamid', '+'
                     FROM   r5urlparameters
                     WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab AND url_parametername = 'internal_eamid')
                     INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_tab, url_parametername, url_system)
                     SELECT DISTINCT @sFunction, @sTab, 'tenant', '+'
                     FROM   r5urlparameters
                     WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab AND url_parametername = 'tenant')
                     INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_tab, url_parametername, url_system)
                     SELECT DISTINCT @sFunction, @sTab, 'USER_FUNCTION_NAME', '+'
                     FROM   r5urlparameters
                     WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab AND url_parametername = 'USER_FUNCTION_NAME')
                     INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_tab, url_parametername, url_system)
                     SELECT DISTINCT @sFunction, @sTab, 'SYSTEM_FUNCTION_NAME', '+'
                     FROM   r5urlparameters
                     WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab AND url_parametername = 'SYSTEM_FUNCTION_NAME')
                     INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_tab, url_parametername, url_system)
                     SELECT DISTINCT @sFunction, @sTab, 'CURRENT_TAB_NAME', '+'
                     FROM   r5urlparameters
                     WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sFunction AND url_tab = @sTab AND url_parametername = 'CURRENT_TAB_NAME')
                   END
                 FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sFunction, @sTab, @sType
              END
          CLOSE c_inserted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

create trigger POSINS_FUE
on r5fuels
for insert
as
	declare @sUser          nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn        int
	declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDesc          nvarchar(200)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select fue_code, fue_desc from inserted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'FUEL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_GDP
on R5GRIDPARAM
for insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nGridid     	numeric(14,0)       
	declare @sParam      	nvarchar(50)        
	declare @sTagname    	nvarchar(60)        
	declare @sDatatype   	nvarchar(10)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	GDP_GRIDID,	GDP_PARAM,	GDP_TAGNAME,	GDP_DATATYPE,	GDP_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	GDP_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nGridid,	@sParam,	@sTagname,	@sDatatype,	@nUpdatecount,
														@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
                            INSERT INTO r5alertgridparams(agp_alert, agp_param)
                                SELECT alt_code, @sParam
                                  FROM r5alerts
                                 WHERE alt_gridid = @nGridid
                                   AND not exists (SELECT 1
                                                     FROM r5alertgridparams
                                                    WHERE agp_alert = alt_code
                                                      AND agp_param = @sParam)

							fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nGridid,	@sParam,	@sTagname,	@sDatatype,	@nUpdatecount,
																@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_GLI
on R5GLINTERFACE
for insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(6)
	declare @sConcat			nvarchar(256)
	declare @sProcess			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sTemp				nvarchar(64)
	declare @nEntries			integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			set @nEntries = @@ROWCOUNT 
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--doesn't matter which row we get the value from
					select @sProcess = gli_process from inserted

					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_process', @sProcess
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_trantype', N'GLFEED'
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					execute @nReturn = o7dflt @sOrg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT  
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					if @sOrg is null or @sChk <> N'0'
						begin
							set @sConcat = N'There is no default org value in installation parameter DEFORG or there' + 
											N' is error in the function to get the value ' + @sChk
							raiserror( @sConcat, 16, 1 )
							rollback transaction
							return
						end
					
					--execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_totentries', @sTemp OUTPUT
					--if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					--	begin
					--		rollback transaction
					--		return
					--	end

					--set @nEntries = cast( @sTemp as integer )

					INSERT INTO r5xmltranstatus (	xts_trantype,
													xts_table,
													xts_keyfld1,
													xts_keyfld2,
													xts_keyfld3,
													xts_keyfld4,
													xts_keyfld5,
													xts_keyflddate1,
													xts_datafld1,
													xts_datafld2,
													xts_org
												   )
						select	N'GLFEED',
								N'GLINTERFACE',
								gli_transid,
								gli_runid,
								gli_entryid,
								gli_process,
								gli_group,
								dbo.f_trunc_date( GetDate(), N'DD' ),
								gli_seqnum,
								@nEntries,
								@sOrg
						from inserted i
						where NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' 
											FROM r5xmltranstatus 
											WHERE xts_keyfld2 = i.gli_runid )

					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_trantype', N'POSTJOURNAL'
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							rollback transaction
							return
						end
					
					--execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_numentries', '0'
					--if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					--	begin
					--		rollback transaction
					--		return
					--	end
				end
		end
