create trigger POSINS_HOM
on R5HOME
for insert NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(24)
	declare @sType			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sGroupBy		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select HOM_CODE, HOM_DESC, HOM_TYPE, HOM_GROUPBYTEXT from inserted 
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sType, @sGroupBy
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							set @sTemp = @sCode + N'#' + @sType

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'HOME', @sX, N'*', @sTemp, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sType = N'C'
								begin
									set @sTemp = @sTemp + N'#GB'
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'HOME', @sX, N'*', @sTemp, N'*', @sGroupBy, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sType, @sGroupBy
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_HYP
on r5hyperlink
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser        nvarchar(38)
  declare @sX           nvarchar(1)
  declare @sCheckresult nvarchar(4)
  declare @nHypLinkNum  numeric(8,0)
  declare @sHypLinkName nvarchar(80)
  declare @sHypPageName nvarchar(40)
  declare @nReturn      int

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON

      declare c_inserted cursor local for
        select hyp_pk, hyp_linkname, hyp_sourcepagename
        from inserted

      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          open c_inserted
          fetch next from c_inserted into @nHypLinkNum, @sHypLinkName, @sHypPageName
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              set @sCheckresult = N'0'
              set @sX = null

              execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'HYPL', @sX, N'*', @nHypLinkNum, N'*', @sHypLinkName, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_inserted
                  deallocate c_inserted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                begin
                  close c_inserted
                  deallocate c_inserted
                  execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              /* Force page cache updatecount update. */
              update r5pagecache 
              set    pgc_updatecount = pgc_updatecount
              where  pgc_function    = substring( @sHypPageName, 1, charindex( N'_', @sHypPageName ) - 1 )
              and    pgc_tabname     = substring( @sHypPageName, charindex( N'_', @sHypPageName ) + 1, 100 )

              fetch next from c_inserted into @nHypLinkNum, @sHypLinkName, @sHypPageName
            end
          close c_inserted
        end
      deallocate c_inserted
    end

create trigger POSINS_KBA
on R5KBARTICLES
for insert
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode               	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg                	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDesc               	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sStatus             	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus            	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sServiceproblem     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sServiceproblem_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sMrc                	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sSupplier           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sSupplier_org       	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sServicecategory    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sServicecategory_org	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDocument           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @dCreated            	datetime            
	declare @dUpdated            	datetime            
	declare @sUpdatedby          	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sCreatedby          	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount        	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity        	integer  
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	KBA_CODE,	KBA_ORG,	KBA_DESC,	KBA_STATUS,	KBA_RSTATUS,
													  	KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM,	KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG,	KBA_MRC,	KBA_SUPPLIER,	KBA_SUPPLIER_ORG,
													  	KBA_SERVICECATEGORY,	KBA_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG,	KBA_DOCUMENT,	KBA_CREATED,	KBA_UPDATED,
													  	KBA_UPDATEDBY,	KBA_CREATEDBY,	KBA_UPDATECOUNT,	KBA_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
														@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@sMrc,	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,
														@sServicecategory,	@sServicecategory_org,	@sDocument,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
														@sUpdatedby,	@sCreatedby,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
                            if @sRstatus <> N'0'
                                begin
							        execute @nReturn = dbo.O7INSKRF1 @sCode, @sOrg, @sMrc,
											        @sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @sServicecategory,
											        @sServicecategory_org, @sServiceproblem, @sServiceproblem_org,
											        @sStatus
							        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								        begin
									        close c_inserted
									        deallocate c_inserted
									        rollback transaction
									        return
								        end
                                end

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                           				set @sX = NULL
                            				execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'KWBS', N'*', N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
																@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@sMrc,	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,
																@sServicecategory,	@sServicecategory_org,	@sDocument,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_MAA
ON r5mailattribs
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @template       NVARCHAR( 18 )
  DECLARE @table          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @pk             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @notebookemails NVARCHAR( 1 )
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT maa_template, maa_table, maa_pk
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN c_ins 
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @template, @table, @pk
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @table = N'R5MOBILENOTEBOOKS'
            BEGIN
              SELECT @notebookemails = mat_notebookemails
              FROM   r5mailtemplate
              WHERE  mat_code = @template
              IF @notebookemails = N'+'
                BEGIN
                  INSERT INTO r5mailparameters( map_table, map_template, map_column, map_parameter, map_attribpk )
                  VALUES( @table, @template, N'MNB_MNECODE', 1, @pk )
                  INSERT INTO r5mailconditions( mac_table, mac_template, mac_column, mac_criteria, mac_attribpk )
                  VALUES( @table, @template, N'MNB_EMAILADDRESS', 'IS NOT NULL', @pk )
                END
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @template, @table, @pk
        END
      CLOSE c_ins
      DEALLOCATE c_ins
    END
END

on R5MRCS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sNotused		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select MRC_CLASS, MRC_CLASS_ORG, MRC_DESC, MRC_CODE, MRC_ORG, MRC_NOTUSED from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sCode, @sOrg, @sNotused
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'MRC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
								
							-- add Databridge event to r5xmltranstatus table
							SELECT @sFlag = isnull(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'
							if upper(@sFlag) = N'A'
							begin
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
								(XTS_TRANTYPE,XTS_TABLE,XTS_KEYFLD1,XTS_KEYFLD2,XTS_KEYFLD3,XTS_ORG,XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
								VALUES
								(N'CODEDEF',N'DEPARTMENT',@sCode,@sDesc,@sNotused,@sOrg,@sTempMsgid)
							end									
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sCode, @sOrg, @sNotused
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSINS_NCF
on r5nonconformities
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser            nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX               nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrg             nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc            nvarchar(80)
    declare @nReturn          int
    declare @nCount         integer
    declare @sFlag          nvarchar(30)    
    declare @sTempMsgid     nvarchar(256)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_inserted cursor local for select NCF_CODE, NCF_ORG, NCF_DESC from inserted
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_inserted 
                    fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'NOCF', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

                            
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

			    -- databridge event
			    select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@NOCF'
                            if @nCount > 0
                                select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@NOCF'
                            else
                                set @sFlag = N'N'
                                
                            if @sFlag = N'Y'
			        begin
			            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT                                                                            
			            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			                begin
			                    close c_inserted
			                    deallocate c_inserted
			                    rollback transaction
			                    return
			                end                          
			                                        
			            INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS (
			                XTS_TRANTYPE,
			                XTS_TABLE,
			                XTS_KEYFLD1,
			                XTS_ORG,
			                XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
			            SELECT N'NONCONFORMITY',
			                   N'R5NONCONFORMITIES',
			                   @sCode,
			                   @sOrg,
			                   @sTempMsgid
			            WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM R5XMLTRANSTATUS WHERE XTS_TRANTYPE = N'NONCONFORMITY' 
			                                                               AND XTS_KEYFLD1 = @sCode AND XTS_ORG = @sOrg )
                                end


                            fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc
                        end
                    close c_inserted
                end
            deallocate c_inserted
        end

                           return
                        end

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @sObrtype = N'L'
                        begin
                           execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'LOC', N'*', N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end
                        end

                     execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'NEW', N'OBJ', N'-', @sStatus
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @nErecord > 0
                        begin
                           execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT
                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYNUM @sCertnum OUTPUT
                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYTYPE @sCerttype OUTPUT
                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           /* Elec archive. */
                           execute @nReturn = o7esignarchiveobj @sCode, @sOrg, @sGetUser, @sGetStype, @sCertnum, @sCerttype, N'INSERT'
                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_inserted
                                 deallocate c_inserted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                     end

                     fetch next from c_inserted into @sObtype, @sObrtype, @sCode, @sDesc, @sStatus, @sOrg
                  end
               close c_inserted
            end
         deallocate c_inserted
      end

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_OBS
ON r5objectsurvey
FOR INSERT
AS
   DECLARE @sUser       nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @sObject     nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @sObjectOrg  nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sType       nvarchar(1)
   DECLARE @sLevelpk    nvarchar(30)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT obs_object, obs_object_org, obs_type, obs_levelpk FROM inserted
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_inserted
               fetch next from c_inserted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sType, @sLevelpk
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     IF @sType = 'O'
                        -- Update column obj_rrsurveylastupdated
                        UPDATE r5objects
                        SET    obj_rrsurveylastupdated = dbo.o7gttime2( @sObjectOrg )
                        WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
                        AND    obj_org  = @sObjectOrg
                        AND    EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                       FROM   r5reliabilityrankinglevels
                                       WHERE  rrl_pk                 = @sLevelpk
                                       AND    rrl_reliabilityranking = obj_reliabilityranking 
                                       AND    rrl_org                = obj_reliabilityranking_org
                                       AND    rrl_revision           = obj_reliabilityrankingrev
                                       AND    rrl_calculated         = '-' )
                     ELSE
                        -- Update column rrv_surveylastupdated
                        UPDATE r5reliabilityrankingvalues
                        SET    rrv_surveylastupdated = dbo.o7gttime2( rrv_org ),
                               rrv_reliabilityrankingscore = NULL,
                               rrv_reliabilityrankingindex = NULL,
                               rrv_valueslastcalculated = NULL
                        WHERE  rrv_pk = @sObject

                     fetch next from c_inserted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sType, @sLevelpk
                  end
               close c_inserted
            end
         deallocate c_inserted
      end

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_OPA
ON r5organizationoptions
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sUser       nvarchar(38)
  DECLARE @sOpaCode    nvarchar(8)
  DECLARE @sOpaOrg     nvarchar(15)
  DECLARE @sOpaSystem  nvarchar(1)
  DECLARE @sDefOrg     nvarchar(15)
  DECLARE @sChk        nvarchar(3) 
  DECLARE @nReturn     int
  
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT opa_code, opa_org, opa_system FROM inserted
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN    
          EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
            RETURN
          OPEN c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sOpaCode, @sOpaOrg, @sOpaSystem
            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
              BEGIN
                IF @sOpaOrg = @sDefOrg
                  BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO r5organizationoptions ( opa_code,
                                                        opa_org,
                                                        opa_system,
                                                        opa_desc,
                                                        opa_comment,
                                                        opa_fixed,
                                                        opa_module,
                                                        opa_type,
                                                        opa_validvalues )
                    SELECT opa_code,
                           org_code,
                           opa_system,
                           opa_desc,
                           opa_comment,
                           opa_fixed,
                           opa_module,
                           opa_type,
                           opa_validvalues
                    FROM  r5organizationoptions, r5organization
                    WHERE opa_code   = @sOpaCode
                    AND   opa_org    = @sOpaOrg
                    AND   opa_system = @sOpaSystem
                    AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5organizationoptions
                                    WHERE opa_org    = org_code
                                    AND   opa_code   = @sOpaCode
                                    AND   opa_system = @sOpaSystem )
                  END
                FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sOpaCode, @sOpaOrg, @sOpaSystem
              END
          CLOSE c_inserted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted  
    END

                                        fetch next from c_inserted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource,@nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime,@sActive, @nUpdateCount
                                        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                                                begin

                                                        UPDATE r5objects SET obj_resourcepresent = '+'

                                                        INSERT INTO r5objresourcesaudit(
                                                            era_object,
                                                            era_object_org,
                                                            era_resource,

                                                            era_active,

                                                        VALUES (

                                                            @sResource,
                                                            @nCoolDownTime,
                                                            @nWarmupTime,
                                                            @sActive,

                                                end

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_PCT
ON R5PARTCONDITIONTEMPLATE
FOR INSERT
AS
	DECLARE @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	DECLARE @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sX					nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	DECLARE @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sCreatedBy			nvarchar(255)
	DECLARE @dCreated     		datetime
	DECLARE @nReturn			int

	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT PCT_CODE, PCT_ORG, PCT_DESC, PCT_CREATEDBY, PCT_CREATED FROM inserted
			SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
				BEGIN
					OPEN c_inserted 
					FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							SET @sCheckresult = N'0'
							SET @sX = NULL	

							EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'PCTL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_inserted
									DEALLOCATE c_inserted
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END
								
							IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_inserted
									DEALLOCATE c_inserted
									EXECUTE O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END
								
								INSERT INTO R5PARTCTPLCONDITIONS(PTC_TEMPLATE, PTC_TEMPLATE_ORG, PTC_CONDITION, PTC_DESC, PTC_CREATEDBY, PTC_CREATED)
								SELECT @sCode, @sOrg, N'*', atx_text, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated
								FROM   r5install, r5alltexts
								WHERE  atx_lang     = ins_desc
								AND    ins_code     = N'DEFLANG'
								AND    atx_texttype = N'BOIL'
								AND    atx_code     = N'27689'
								/* Redo translations. */
								DELETE FROM r5descriptions
								WHERE  des_rentity = N'CPCT'
								AND    des_code    = @sCode + N'#*'
								AND    des_org     = @sOrg
								INSERT INTO r5descriptions( des_entity, des_rentity, des_type, des_rtype, des_code, des_lang, des_text, des_trans, des_org )
								SELECT N'CPCT', N'CPCT', N'*', N'*', @sCode + N'#*', atx_lang, atx_text, N'+', @sOrg
								FROM   r5langinst, r5alltexts
								WHERE  atx_lang     = lin_code
								AND    atx_texttype = N'BOIL'
								AND    atx_code     = N'27689'

							FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated
						END
					CLOSE c_inserted
				END
			DEALLOCATE c_inserted
		END

for insert

   declare @sObject        nvarchar(30)

   declare @nOperationSeq  numeric(8)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
              /* get eam user */
         execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sEAMUser OUTPUT
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return
      
         set @sEAMUser = coalesce(@sEAMUser, N'*')
         
              /* get system date */
         execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, null
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
           return
           
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_inserted cursor local for select pmr_ppm, pmr_ppmrevision, pmr_object, pmr_object_org, pmr_resource, pmr_operationseq, pmr_cooldowntime, pmr_warmuptime, pmr_downtime, pmr_offset, pmr_offsetvalue, pmr_active from inserted

               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

                     VALUES (

                         @sObject,
                         @sObjectOrg,
                         @sResource,
                         @nOperationSeq,
                         @nCoolDownTime,
                         @nWarmupTime,
                         @nDownTime,
                         @sActive,
                         @sOffset,
                         @nOffsetValue,
                         N'INS',
                         @sEAMUser,
                         @dDate )   
                     fetch next from c_inserted into @sPpm, @nPpmRev, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource, @nOperationSeq, @nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime, @nDownTime, @sOffset, @nOffsetValue, @sActive

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_PPO
ON R5PPMOBJECTS
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sUser         NVARCHAR( 38 )
  DECLARE @sPpm          NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @nRev          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sObject       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sObjorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sChk          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sX            NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @nIcr          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sObj          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sOrg          NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @nReturn       INT
  DECLARE @sResource     NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @nCooldowntime NUMERIC( 18, 2 )
  DECLARE @nWarmuptime   NUMERIC( 18, 2 )
  DECLARE @sActive       NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @nSeq          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nPpopk             integer
  DECLARE @dPpoDue              DATETIME
  DECLARE @nPpoFreq             NUMERIC(8)
  DECLARE @sPpoPerioduom        NVARCHAR(10)
  DECLARE @sPerformonweek       NVARCHAR(1)
  DECLARE @nPerformonday        NUMERIC(1)
  DECLARE @dDeactive            DATETIME
  DECLARE @sPpoIssType          nvarchar(1)
  DECLARE @sRstat               nvarchar(4)

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT ppo_ppm, ppo_revision, ppo_object, ppo_object_org, ppo_pk, ppo_due, 
                ppo_freq, ppo_perioduom, ppo_performonweek, ppo_performonday, ppo_deactive, ppo_isstype FROM inserted
      SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sPpm, @nRev, @sObject, @sObjorg, @nPpopk, @dPpoDue, @nPpoFreq, @sPpoPerioduom,
                                            @sPerformonweek, @nPerformonday, @dDeactive, @sPpoIssType 
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @sX = null
              SELECT @sX = 'x'
              FROM   r5pmresources
              WHERE  pmr_ppm         = @sPpm
              AND    pmr_ppmrevision = @nRev
              AND    pmr_object      = @sObject
              AND    pmr_object_org  = @sObjorg
              IF @sX IS NULL
                BEGIN
                  /* If not, create them now. First retrieve object to copy from. */
                  EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gterpe @sObject, @sObjorg, N'-', @sObj OUTPUT, @sOrg OUTPUT
                  IF @sObj IS NOT NULL
                    /* Copy records. */
                    BEGIN
                      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7dflt @nIcr OUTPUT, N'INCRLINO', @sChk OUTPUT
                      SET @nSeq = 0
                      DECLARE c_ors CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
                        SELECT ors_resource, ors_cooldowntime, ors_warmuptime, ors_active
                        FROM   r5objresources
                        WHERE  ors_object     = @sObj
                        AND    ors_object_org = @sOrg  
                      OPEN c_ors
                      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ors INTO @sResource, @nCooldowntime, @nWarmuptime, @sActive
                      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        BEGIN
                          SET @nSeq = @nSeq + 1
                          INSERT INTO r5pmresources( pmr_ppm, pmr_ppmrevision, pmr_object, pmr_object_org, 
                                 pmr_resource, pmr_cooldowntime, pmr_warmuptime, pmr_operationseq, pmr_active )
                          VALUES( @sPpm, @nRev, @sObject, @sObjorg, 
                                  @sResource, @nCooldowntime, @nWarmuptime, @nSeq * ISNULL( @nIcr, 1 ),  @sActive )
                          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ors INTO @sResource, @nCooldowntime, @nWarmuptime, @sActive
                        END
                      CLOSE c_ors 
                    END 
                END
            IF @sPpoIssType = N'D'
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @sRstat = ppm_revrstatus
                    FROM   r5ppms
                    WHERE  ppm_code = @sPpm
                    AND    ppm_revision = @nRev
                    IF @sRstat = N'A' 
                        /* If duplicate and PM is approved, insert into future duplicates. */
                        execute @nReturn = O7CRFDP1 @nPpoPk, @dPpoDue, @nPpoFreq, @sPpoPerioduom, @sPerformonweek, @nPerformonday,
                                                                    @sObject, @sObjorg, @dDeactive, @sChk OUTPUT
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sPpm, @nRev, @sObject, @sObjorg, @nPpopk, @dPpoDue, @nPpoFreq, @sPpoPerioduom,
                                            @sPerformonweek, @nPerformonday, @dDeactive, @sPpoIssType
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted 
        END
    END

  DECLARE @sMp         NVARCHAR(30)

  DECLARE @nMpRev      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nMpSeq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sObj        NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObjorg     NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @dTarget     DATETIME
  DECLARE @nDuration   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nReturn     NUMERIC

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT evt_code, evt_mp, evt_mp_org, evt_mp_rev, evt_mp_seq, evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_target, evt_duration
      FROM   r5events, inserted
      WHERE  evt_mp      = psq_mp
      AND    evt_mp_org  = psq_mp_org

      AND    evt_rstatus = 'A'
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()

        BEGIN

          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              EXECUTE @nReturn = o7crfut2 @sWo, @sWo, @sMp, @sMporg, @nMprev, @nMpseq,

              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO 
                    @sWo, @sMp, @sMporg, @nMpRev, @nMpseq, @sObj, @sObjorg, @dTarget, @nDuration

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_REQ_S ON R5REQUISITIONS FOR INSERT AS 
BEGIN 
DECLARE @sTMPStoreVal1   NVARCHAR(24) 
       ,@sTenant         NVARCHAR(255) 
       ,@sErrCheck       NVARCHAR(10) 
       ,@sErrMsg         NVARCHAR(240) 
       ,@nReturn         INT 

DECLARE ScrollTMP CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT REQ_SQLIDENTITY  FROM inserted

SELECT @sErrCheck = N'0', @sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN() 
IF @sTenant IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(INT, @sTenant) != -1
   RETURN 

OPEN ScrollTMP 
WHILE 1=1 
      BEGIN 
      FETCH ScrollTMP INTO @sTMPStoreVal1 
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0 
         BREAK 
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSINS_REQ1 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      INSERT INTO FLEX_TRIGGER_WORKAROUND VALUES ( 'R5REQUISITIONS' , 'POST-INSERT', @sTMPStoreVal1 )
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSINS_REQ2 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      END 
CLOSE ScrollTMP 
DEALLOCATE ScrollTMP 
IF @nReturn = -1 
   BEGIN 
   ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 
   RETURN 
   END 
END

        return

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_RQL_S ON R5REQUISLINES FOR INSERT AS 
BEGIN 
DECLARE @sTMPStoreVal1   NVARCHAR(24) 
       ,@sTenant         NVARCHAR(255) 
       ,@sErrCheck       NVARCHAR(10) 
       ,@sErrMsg         NVARCHAR(240) 
       ,@nReturn         INT 

DECLARE ScrollTMP CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT RQL_SQLIDENTITY  FROM inserted

SELECT @sErrCheck = N'0', @sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN() 
IF @sTenant IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(INT, @sTenant) != -1
   RETURN 

OPEN ScrollTMP 
WHILE 1=1 
      BEGIN 
      FETCH ScrollTMP INTO @sTMPStoreVal1 
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0 
         BREAK 
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSINS_RQL1 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      INSERT INTO FLEX_TRIGGER_WORKAROUND VALUES ( 'R5REQUISLINES' , 'POST-INSERT', @sTMPStoreVal1 )
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSINS_RQL2 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      END 
CLOSE ScrollTMP 
DEALLOCATE ScrollTMP 
IF @nReturn = -1 
   BEGIN 
   ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 
   RETURN 
   END 
END

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_RRL
ON r5reliabilityrankinglevels
FOR INSERT
AS
   DECLARE @sUser               nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @sCheckresult        nvarchar(4)
   DECLARE @sX                  nvarchar(1)
   DECLARE @sPk                 nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @sReliabilityranking nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @nRevision           numeric
   DECLARE @sOrg                nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sDesc               nvarchar(80)
   DECLARE @sQuestion           nvarchar(255)
   DECLARE @nReturn             int


   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT rrl_pk, rrl_desc, rrl_org, rrl_question, rrl_reliabilityranking, rrl_revision FROM inserted
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_inserted
               fetch next from c_inserted into @sPk, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sQuestion, @sReliabilityranking, @nRevision
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                     set @sX = null

                     execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'RRLV', @sX, N'*', @sPk, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end


                     -- Add records in r5reliabilityrankingquests
                     IF @sQuestion IS NOT NULL
                        INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingquests( rrq_levelpk, rrq_lang, rrq_question, rrq_trans )
                        SELECT  @sPK, l.lin_code, @sQuestion, CASE i.ins_desc WHEN l.lin_code THEN '+' ELSE '-' END
                        FROM r5langinst l, r5install i
                        WHERE i.ins_code = 'DEFLANG'

                     -- Update column rrk_setuplastupdated
                     UPDATE r5reliabilityrankings
                     SET    rrk_setuplastupdated = getdate()
                     WHERE  rrk_code     = @sReliabilityranking
                     AND    rrk_org      = @sOrg
                     AND    rrk_revision = @nRevision

                     fetch next from c_inserted into @sPk, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sQuestion, @sReliabilityranking, @nRevision
                  end
               close c_inserted
            end
         deallocate c_inserted
      end

create trigger POSINS_SEV
on R5CUSTOMERSURVEYEVENTS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPK				nvarchar(50)
	declare @sSurvey			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSurveyOrg			nvarchar(15)

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCount				integer	
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)
	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select SEV_PK,SEV_SURVEY,SEV_ENTITY,SEV_CODE,SEV_ORG,SEV_SURVEY_ORG from inserted 
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sPK,@sSurvey,@sEntity,@sCode,@sOrg,@sSurveyOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
								
									select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@CUSSRVY'
									if @nCount > 0
										select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@CUSSRVY'
									else
										set @sFlag = N'N'

									if @sFlag = N'Y'
										begin
											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											  begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
											  end
											
											DELETE R5XMLTRANSTATUS
                                                WHERE XTS_TRANTYPE = N'CUSTSURVEYEVENT'
                                                AND XTS_TABLE = N'R5CUSTOMERSURVEYEVENTS'
                                                AND XTS_KEYFLD1 = @sPK
                                                AND XTS_KEYFLD2 = @sSurvey
                                                AND XTS_KEYFLD3 = @sEntity
												AND XTS_KEYFLD4 = @sOrg
												AND XTS_KEYFLD5 = @sCode

											
											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
											   XTS_TABLE,
											   XTS_KEYFLD1,
											   XTS_KEYFLD2,
											   XTS_KEYFLD3,
											   XTS_KEYFLD4,
											   XTS_KEYFLD5,
											   XTS_ORG,
											   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
											  )
											VALUES(

CREATE TRIGGER POSINS_SPB_HOSP
ON r5serviceproblemcodes
FOR INSERT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @code NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @org  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @pk   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @chk  NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @r    INT
  DECLARE @cnt  INT

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT  spb_code,  spb_org
        FROM    inserted
      OPEN c_inserted
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @code, @org
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          /* Check for Hospitality users, should be 2. */
          SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
          FROM   r5users
          WHERE  usr_code IN ( 'HOSPADMN', 'HOSPUSER' )
          IF @cnt = 2
            BEGIN
              /* Check numer of departments, should only be 1. */
              SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
              FROM   r5mrcs
              IF @cnt = 1
                BEGIN
                  EXECUTE @r = r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'DPS', N'1', @chk OUTPUT 
                  IF @pk IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                      INSERT INTO r5departmentstructure( dps_code, dps_mrc )
                      SELECT @pk, '*' 
                      FROM   dual
                      WHERE  NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentstructure WHERE dps_mrc = '*' )
                      EXECUTE @r = r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'DPS', N'1', @chk OUTPUT 
                      IF @pk IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                          INSERT INTO r5departmentstructure( dps_code, dps_mrc, dps_serviceproblem, dps_serviceproblem_org )
                          VALUES( @pk, '*', @code, @org )
                        END
                    END
                END
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @code, @org
        END
      CLOSE c_inserted
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END
END

  declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
  declare @sDesc          nvarchar(80)
  declare @sWODesc		  nvarchar(80)
  declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)
  declare @nReturn        int
  declare @sWOCheckresult nvarchar(4)
  declare @nWOReturn	  int
  declare @sCasemanagement   nvarchar(30)
  declare @sTaskForChklst   	nvarchar(30)
  declare @sTaskRevForChklst   nvarchar(4)
  declare @nProcReturn	  int

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_inserted cursor local for select tcm_code, tcm_desc, tcm_wo_desc, tcm_casemanagement, tcm_chklst_task, tcm_chklst_taskrev from inserted
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
      open c_inserted 
      fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sWODesc, @sCasemanagement, @sTaskForChklst, @sTaskRevForChklst
      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        set @sCheckresult = N'0'
        set @sWOCheckresult = N'0'
        set @sX = null
        set @sOrg = null
        
        /* Insert description */
        execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CMTK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
        execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CATM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
        
        if @sTaskForChklst IS NOT NULL
          begin
    		execute @nProcReturn = o7createactchecklist @sCasemanagement, 0, @sTaskForChklst, @sTaskRevForChklst, 
                      NULL, '%', '-', '-', '-', NULL, @sCode ;
		  end
		/* Reset Case Management esignature information */
		UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null WHERE csm_code = @sCasemanagement;
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0 or @nProcReturn <> 0
        begin
          close c_inserted
          deallocate c_inserted
          rollback transaction
          return
        end

        if @sCheckresult <> N'0' or @sWOCheckresult <> N'0'
        begin
          close c_inserted
          deallocate c_inserted
          execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
          execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sWOCheckresult, @@ERROR
          rollback transaction
        return
        end
        
        
        fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sWODesc, @sCasemanagement, @sTaskForChklst, @sTaskRevForChklst
      end
      close c_inserted
    end
    deallocate c_inserted
  end

create trigger POSINS_TKD
on R5TRACKINGDATA
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     		bigint
	declare @sTrans       		nvarchar(4)                  
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_insert cursor local for select	i.TKD_TRANSID,	i.TKD_TRANS
												from inserted i
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_insert
					fetch next from c_insert into 	@nTransid,	@sTrans
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							-- databridge event
							select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@TKDATA'
																
							if @nCount > 0 
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@TKDATA'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'
							
							if @sFlag = N'Y'
							begin
																				
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
																							
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_insert
									deallocate c_insert
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
								INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
								(XTS_TRANTYPE,
								XTS_TABLE,
								XTS_KEYFLD1,
								XTS_KEYFLD2,
								XTS_KEYFLD3,

create trigger POSINS_TOR
on R5TOOLREQ
for insert
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent         	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer  
	declare @sEventRstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEventRtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParentEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sEventOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dEventInterface	datetime
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)  
	declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)
         

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select TOR_EVENT from inserted
			
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							
							/*************************************************
							  Databridge workorder outbound event
							*************************************************/
							select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
							from r5install
							where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

							if @sFlag = N'A'
							begin
								select	@sEventRstatus = evt_rstatus,
									@sEventRtype = evt_rtype,
									@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
									@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
									@sEventOrg = evt_org,
									@dEventInterface = evt_interface
								from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

								if (@sEventRtype = N'JOB' or @sEventRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sEventRstatus = N'C' or @sEventRstatus = N'R') 
								begin
									select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
									from r5ucodes
									where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
									if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dEventInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dEventInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0

													  	TOU_DATEUSED,	TOU_HOURS,	TOU_TARIFF,	TOU_COST,	TOU_QTY,
													  	TOU_GLTRANSFERFLAG,	TOU_TRANSCODE,	TOU_TRANSORGID,	TOU_TRANSGROUP,	TOU_ACD,

													  	TOU_JECATEGORY,	TOU_JESOURCE,	TOU_SPLITUSAGE, TOU_DESC, TOU_MISC
													from inserted

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

									--NOTE: IF YOU MADE A CHANGE TO THE CODE IN PREINS_TOU THEN YOU NEED TO CHANGE THE CODE BELOW.
									--PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT.
									if @sSplitusage = N'A'
										SELECT @nCount = count(*)
										FROM   r5events

										AND    EXISTS( SELECT 'x'

											WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
											AND    act_act   = @nAct)
									else
										SELECT @nCount = count(*)
										FROM   r5events
										WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sEvent
										AND    ( @sSplitusage = N'O' AND evt_rstatus <> 'C' ) 
										AND    EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
											FROM   r5activities
											WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
											AND    act_act   = @nAct)
									

									if coalesce( @nCount, 0 ) > 0

											insert into o7crtou1_tbl values( @sEvent, @nAct, @dDatebooked, @dDateused, @sMrc, @sTool, @nOrighours, @nTariff, @nCost, @nQty, N'INS', @nCount, @sSplitusage,@sDesc, @sMisc )
										end
								end

								/*************************************************
								  Databridge workorder outbound event
								*************************************************/
								select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
								from r5install
								where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

								if @sFlag = N'A'
								begin
									select	@sEventRstatus = evt_rstatus,
											@sEventRtype = evt_rtype,
											@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
											@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
											@sEventOrg = evt_org,
											@dEventInterface = evt_interface
									from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

									if (@sEventRtype = N'JOB' or @sEventRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sEventRstatus = N'C' or @sEventRstatus = N'R') 
									begin
										select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
										from r5ucodes
										where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
										if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
										begin
											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										
											if @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
											begin
												set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
												select @dEventInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
											end
											else
												set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											(XTS_TRANTYPE,
											XTS_TABLE,
											XTS_KEYFLD1,
											XTS_KEYFLD2,
											XTS_ORG,
											XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
											)
											SELECT
											N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
											N'R5EVENTS',
											@sEventOut,
											CASE WHEN @dEventInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
											@sEventOrg,
											@sTempMsgid
											WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
										end
									end
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dDatebooked,
																@dDateused,	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@nQty,
																@sGltransferflag,	@sTranscode,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@nAcd,
																@dGltransfer,	@nUpdatecount,	@nOrighours,	@sRouterec,	@nSqlidentity,
																@sJecategory,	@sJesource,	@sSplitusage,@sDesc, @sMisc

		end

create trigger POSINS_TSK
on R5TASKS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCurruser		nvarchar(255)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sIsJobPlan		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sEntity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @dGttime		datetime
	declare @nRevision		numeric(4)
	declare @sKeyCode		nvarchar(40)
	declare @sWODesc		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sWOCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nWOReturn		int
	declare @sTagHeader		nvarchar(25)
	declare @sTagLine1		nvarchar(60)
	declare @sTagLine2		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTagLine3		nvarchar(150)
	declare @sTagLine4		nvarchar(150)
	declare @nTHReturn		int
	declare @nTL1Return		int
	declare @nTL2Return		int
	declare @nTL3Return		int
	declare @nTL4Return		int
	
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select TSK_CODE, TSK_ORG, TSK_DESC, TSK_REVISION, TSK_WODESC, TSK_JOBPLAN, 
			TSK_TAGHEADER, TSK_TAGLINE1, TSK_TAGLINE2, TSK_TAGLINE3, TSK_TAGLINE4 from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @nRevision, @sWODesc, @sIsJobPlan,
					@sTagHeader, @sTagLine1, @sTagLine2, @sTagLine3, @sTagLine4
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @sKeyCode = @sCode + '#' + CAST(@nRevision AS nvarchar(4))
							if @sIsJobPlan = N'+' set @sEntity = N'JBPL'
							else set @sEntity = N'TASK'
							/* W2324 - Insert descriptions */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, @sEntity, @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'TASW', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
							
							/* Long descriptions for Permit to work Tags */
							execute @nTHReturn  = O7LONGDESCS N'INS', N'TGHD', @sKeyCode, @sTagHeader
							execute @nTL1Return = O7LONGDESCS N'INS', N'TGL1', @sKeyCode, @sTagLine1
							execute @nTL2Return = O7LONGDESCS N'INS', N'TGL2', @sKeyCode, @sTagLine2
							execute @nTL3Return = O7LONGDESCS N'INS', N'TGL3', @sKeyCode, @sTagLine3
							execute @nTL4Return = O7LONGDESCS N'INS', N'TGL4', @sKeyCode, @sTagLine4
							   
   						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0 or @nTHReturn <> 0 or @nTL1Return <> 0 or @nTL2Return <> 0 or @nTL3Return <> 0 or @nTL4Return <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0' or @sWOCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sWOCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							/* Do insert of approve header */
							execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCurruser OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGttime OUTPUT, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							INSERT INTO r5entappheader ( eah_rentity, eah_code, eah_revision, eah_user, eah_date )
							VALUES( @sEntity, @sCode, @nRevision, @sCurruser, @dGttime );

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @nRevision, @sWODesc, @sIsJobPlan,
							@sTagHeader, @sTagLine1, @sTagLine2, @sTagLine3, @sTagLine4
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end
